186283.flavor: "Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life." - Zurke
186283.name: Gloves_Unique_Generic_002
186283.power: Your attacks randomly deal 1% to 250-300% of their normal damage.

203309.flavor: After Inarius returned to Sanctuary, he sought a way back to the High Heavens. His first step was to reignite the religion he had abandoned millennia before: the Cathedral of Light.
203309.name: Gloves_Unique_Sorc_002
203309.power: Fireball now bounces as it travels, exploding each time it hits the ground, but its explosion deals 70-100% of normal damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 1 Fireball

208264.flavor: Remorseful devotees of the Cathedral of Light must undertake a grueling pilgrimage, journeying across the frigid glacier known as the Serac Rapture. Only then may their gravest sins be forgiven.
208264.name: Boots_Unique_Generic_001
208264.power: You are permanently Unhindered and leave behind a trail of frost that Chills enemies. Your Chill effects cause enemies to take 10-15% increased damage from you.

221017.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.
221017.name: 1HSword_Unique_Generic_001
221017.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% chance to deal # Shadow damage to surrounding enemies and reduce their damage dealt by 25% for 5 seconds.

223271.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.
223271.name: 2HSword_Unique_Generic_001
223271.power: Increases your Critical Strike Damage by 120%.

223287.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.
223287.name: 1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001
223287.power: Your attacks Critically Strike Injured Enemies. Killing Elites Fears and Slows nearby enemies by 85-95% for 2 seconds.

223465.flavor: "What plague has befouled, let fire make clean. What agony these good people have suffered, let it settle quietly in the dust." -General Arenton
223465.name: 2HMace_Unique_Generic_001
223465.power: You deal 75-100% more damage to Elites.

224074.flavor: "There have been numerous world-shaping conflicts throughout history. This bow has been found on the battlefield of every one, and always in the hands of the victors." - Barrett's Book of Implements
224074.name: 2HBow_Unique_Rogue_006
224074.power: Hits of Barrage have a 25-30% chance to deal triple damage and Knock Down enemies.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Core Barrage

241930.flavor: The horrific whispers of the Maiden of Anguish flicker through your mind, pushing you ever closer to madness...
241930.name: Helm_Unique_Generic_001
241930.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a 20% chance to trigger a poison nova that deals 40% of the damage dealt over 5 seconds to enemies in the area.

254721.flavor: A touch so frigid it stops the heart and chills the very soul.
254721.name: Gloves_Unique_Generic_003
254721.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a 50% chance to Freeze enemies for 1 second. You deal 40-50% increased damage to Frozen enemies.

291609.flavor: "We've been fighting these flesh-eaters for so long, been soaked in so much blood, that after a while it's difficult to tell what side you're truly on." -Daelyr, Crane Tribe warrior
291609.name: 2HSword_Unique_Barb_002
291609.power: Rupture's rip deals 37.5-50% of the total Bleeding damage on an enemy instantly, removing all Bleeding damage from them.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Special Rupture

291669.flavor: "Considered a failure by their creator, it wasn't until the assassination of an "untouchable" Caldeum noble that these boots' true power was understood." - Barrett's Book of Implements
291669.name: Boots_Unique_Generic_002
291669.power: Each enemy you Evade through reduces your active Ultimate Cooldown by 3-4 seconds, up to 10 seconds.

300735.flavor: "The brutish construction of these gloves belies the strength they bestow. Gohr was clearly no craftsman, but it would be foolish to ignore the triumph of his work." -Barrett's Book of Implements
300735.name: Gloves_Unique_Barb_001
300735.power: Whirlwind deals 75-90% increased damage and pulls enemies to you every 2 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Core Whirlwind

344413.flavor: The demon prince Ikonoth slew hundreds of the Heavenly Host with this infernal hammer before falling to none other than the Archangel Imperius himself.
344413.name: 2HMace_Unique_Barb_001
344413.power: Upheaval gains the Iron Burst Variant for free and deals 60-75% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Core Upheaval

354700.flavor: "She has existed in Scosglen since before Fiacla-Géar walked the land. Her purpose is a mystery to us all. However, approach her with deference; she may grant you her counsel."-Airidah, to Donan
354700.name: 2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001
354700.power: Claw gains all Variants for free and deals 60-75% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Basic Claw

356745.flavor: "Weapons wielded by the fiercest warriors often catch the eye of the Ancient spirits. If the wielder is worthy, the spirits may bless the steel with their strength." -Gerti, Oxen Tribe Forgemaster
356745.name: 2HAxe_Unique_Barb_001
356745.power: Enemies hit by Steel Grasp take 45-60% increased damage from you for 9 seconds.

357812.flavor: "He was not a victim of the curse. He sought it out. As his muscles grew and body changed from man to beast, his laughter never ceased." – Tale of the Mad Nobleman
357812.name: Chest_Unique_Druid_002
357812.power: Lacerate has no Cooldown, costs 100 Spirit to cast and deals 80-100% bonus damage but no longer grants Immunity. Lacerate is also a Core Skill.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

359165.flavor: "The angel Lycander left us a portion of her power in this spear. It is all the proof I need that she watches over us still." - Oracle Argoysni
359165.name: 2HStaff_Unique_Generic_100
359165.power: Gain a random Shrine effect for 20 seconds after killing an Elite enemy. Can only occur once every 30 seconds.

359352.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.
359352.name: 1HSword_Unique_Generic_100
359352.power: After Freeze expires, enemies take 120-150% of the damage you dealt to them while Frozen.

359743.flavor: "Genai took up her bow and aimed at the sun itself. The light burned her eyes, but her arrow flew true. Wounded, the sun hid, and brought forth the first night." - Fable of the Great Sky-Hunt
359743.name: 2HBow_Unique_Rogue_001
359743.power: Every consecutive Cast of Rapid Fire increases the amount of arrows it fires by 2, up to 6. Rapid Fire deals 40-50% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Core Rapid Fire

397700.flavor: "This weapon is a reminder of the unbridled savagery of our druidic ancestors, the wisdom of which I see more clearly with every day that passes." - Moreg, Druidic Scholar
397700.name: 1HMace_Unique_Druid_001
397700.power: Tornadoes deal 100-135% increased damage and when expire, they instead seek back toward you.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Core Tornado

418017.flavor: The power you have is never enough.
418017.name: Chest_Unique_Sorc_002
418017.power: Teleport pulls Close enemies to you and you gain 40-50 Damage Reduction for 8 seconds.

451091.flavor: "I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers." - Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot
451091.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001
451091.power: Your Core Skills deal 45-60% increased damage for 5 seconds when Consuming 3 Combo Points. Casting Basic Skills always generates 3 Combo Points. Generating Combo Points allows you to generate the same amount of Combo Points for 1.5 |4second:seconds; when you spend them.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

455405.flavor: Beware, for the serpent's spirit lingers. Those who don the Nirmitruq's visage may find their hearts entwined with the viper's wrath.
455405.name: Helm_Unique_Rogue_002
455405.power: Flurry gains the Transporter Variant for free. You can now overexert yourself while Casting Flurry, spending 3% life when you don't have enough Energy. Spending life to Cast Flurry increases its damage by 60-75% and your Attack Speed by 50% for 5 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Core Flurry

469648.flavor: When Caldeum's gates closed, Asheara led her Iron Wolves out of the city knowing full well they would never return. Instead they roamed Kehjistan pledging their blades to any who were in need.
469648.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_002
469648.power: Hits with this weapon increase your Attack Speed by #% and damage by #% for 4 seconds, up to #% and #% respectively.

470539.flavor: "And so, when the sun dipped behind the hills each night, he knew that Ashen Jack would soon be near. Watching, and waiting." - Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 2: "Each Long Night"
470539.name: Pants_Unique_Rogue_004
470539.power: Death Trap deals 75-90% increased damage and will rearm itself after activating, once every 10 seconds.

494989.flavor: "He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been." - Excerpt from a burned parchment
494989.name: Helm_Unique_Rogue_001
494989.power: Lucky Hit: Imbued Skills have up to a 40% chance to trigger a large explosion, dealing 75% of the damage dealt and applying the Imbuement effect to each enemy it hits with 120-150% Potency.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Category Imbuements

609820.flavor: "This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage." - The Fall of House Aston
609820.name: Helm_Unique_Generic_002

873651.flavor: When the Days of Ash began, the great druid Nafain reminded his disciples that nothing, not even the loss of their humanity, was too great a sacrifice to protect Túr Dúlra from Astaroth's flames.
873651.name: Chest_Unique_Druid_003
873651.power: For 2 seconds after Casting Trample, you may Cast Trample again without incurring the Cooldown. Trample additionally deals 150-200% bonus damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Trample

880590.flavor: "The storm's rage is my own, brother. I call, and the skies roar in reply." - Vasily, to Bul-Kathos
880590.name: Pants_Unique_Druid_001
880590.power: Your Wolf Companions are infused with the power of the storm, dealing 80-100% increased Lightning damage and gaining the Storm Howl ability.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Wolves

989678.flavor: "By fang, claw, spear, or sword - send the bastards back to the flames from which they crawled! Soak the peat with their blood! For Fiacla-Géar! For Scosglen!" - Nafain, during the Days of Ash
989678.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_003
989678.power: When Hurricane ends or after it lasts 10 seconds, an explosion occurs dealing 75-90% of the total damage dealt by up to 40 hits of Hurricane.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Hurricane

1063172.flavor: "Leaving even blackened bones for your kin to mourn is too good an end for you." - Josiah
1063172.name: 2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_002
1063172.power: Fireball deals 70-90% increased damage and every 3rd Cast launches 2 additional projectiles.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 1 Fireball

1206099.flavor: This crossbow is marred by a hundred battles. Mercy is its stranger. When its quarrel flies, a generation weeps.
1206099.name: 2HCrossbow_Unique_Rogue_100
1206099.power: Basic and Core Skills that use this weapon now Reload. Reload Skills deal 40-50% increased damage and every second Reload Skill increases this bonus by 100% for 2 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Category Marksman

1210594.flavor: "While many Barbarians remained in the Dreadlands, small groups from the Oxen, Crane, and Bear tribes instead chose to search the land for a new home." -A History of the Children of Bul-Kathos
1210594.name: Boots_Unique_Barb_100
1210594.power: Ground Stomp's damage is increased by 20-25% plus an additional amount based on the distance traveled since the last casted Ground Stomp's, up to 80-100%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Special Ground Stomp

1211654.flavor: "Her lover's spirit faded, and in her sorrow she wept frozen tears. Where they fell, roses of the purest ice would blossom each winter." - Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 7: "The Myth of Irina Coldheart"
1211654.name: Ring_Unique_Sorc_100
1211654.power: Skills that form Ice Spikes deal 80-100% increased damage. Lucky Hit: Up to a 15% chance to form an exploding Ice Spike, dealing # Cold damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Category Frost

1214792.flavor: The burn may heal, but the pain is eternal.
1214792.name: 1HWand_Unique_Sorc_100
1214792.power: Incinerate gains one final charge, irradiating the area around you and increasing damage dealt by 200-300% but costing an additional 50 Mana per second.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 5 Incinerate

1215065.flavor: Crafted by the cannibal Armoda, each piece of this interlocking armor has been sharpened into a knife's edge. Even a century after death, the plate remained on her corpse, unable to be removed safely.
1215065.name: Chest_Unique_Generic_100
1215065.power: Thorns has a 30% chance to deal 200-250% increased damage.

1215134.flavor: "Every tome, every scroll, every book in this temple produces the same answer. The only being willing to stand against the Eternal Conflict, against the Prime Evils, was Lilith." - Elias
1215134.name: Ring_Unique_Generic_100
1215134.power: If a Core Skill hits 4 or more enemies, 50-60% of the Resource cost is refunded.

1217040.flavor: A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.
1217040.name: Pants_Unique_Necro_100
1217040.power: Your Summons have a 7-10% chance to randomly inflict Decrepify or Iron Maiden when they deal damage. You deal 50-60% increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies affected by your Curses.

1219220.flavor: "The assassin moved as though in a dance - left, pivot, cut. The guests did not realize they had been split until their screams gurgled through the slits in their necks." - An Account at the Red Feast
1219220.name: Pants_Unique_Rogue_100
1219220.power: Dance of Knives drops knives from enemies hit. Picking them up grants you 25 Energy and increases your Dance of Knives damage by 25-30% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Dance Of Knives

1220208.flavor: "My companion swung her odd weapon in a wide arc, and our pursuer stopped short. The look of horror on his face as his body fell to pieces will haunt me forever." -The Ebon Pages, Canto II, Verse XI
1220208.name: 2HScythe_Unique_Necro_100
1220208.power: Your Darkness Skills Chill enemies for up to 100% and deal 100-125% increased damage to Frozen enemies and bosses. Every 800 times you damage enemies with Darkness Skills, all Nearby enemies are Feared for 0.25 seconds before Freezing for 3 more seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Category Darkness

1220258.flavor: "The massive door to my family's crypt, which had taken a dozen men to close, was thrown open. Had I known the horrors to come I never would have set foot inside!" -The Ebon Pages, Canto I, Verse VII
1220258.name: Boots_Unique_Necro_100
1220258.power: Sever leaves behind Desecrated Ground that deals # Corrupting damage over 2 seconds.

1222182.flavor: The malformed snake creatures that live in the swamps are not content with simply killing their prey. They seem to take a malicious pleasure from inflicting as much suffering as possible before death.
1222182.name: 2HMace_Unique_Barb_100
1222182.power: Death Blow gains all Upgrades for free and deals 60-75% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Special Death Blow

1222627.flavor: The signet of Mendeln ul-Diomed, the founder of the Priests of Rathma and the first Necromancer, was lost for over 3,000 years. The immense power over death held within, however, has not diminished.
1222627.name: Ring_Unique_Necro_100
1222627.power: Every 6th attack from each Minion is empowered, exploding for # Physical damage.

1224619.flavor: "The Cathedral of Light's earliest attempts at crafting their penitent armor was to infuse the plate with painful blood magic, before such acts were deemed heretical." -Barrett's Book of Implements
1224619.name: Chest_Unique_Necro_100
1224619.power: You are Blood Lanced, and when Blood Lance would deal damage to you, it instead Fortifies you for 5% of your Maximum Life and has a 10% chance to form a Blood Orb. Blood Lance deals 70-90% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Core Blood Lance

1225300.flavor: The only thing more potent than Esadora's magic was her endless hatred of humanity. As she lay dying, the pale amulet around her neck drank in both.
1225300.name: Amulet_Unique_Sorc_100
1225300.power: Crackling Energy's discharge rate is increased by your Attack Speed, it's damage is increased by #%, and each hit has a 25% chance to reduce a random Cooldown by 1 second.

1225568.flavor: "Fool said he dug it out of the sands near Lut Gholein with a few other 'worthless trinkets'. I hid my delight at receiving such a treasure in exchange for a meager handful of coins." - Rakhaan
1225568.name: Ring_Unique_Sorc_101
1225568.power: Casting a Pyromancy, Shock, or Frost Skill increases your damage by 10-20% for 8 seconds, stacking once per Element. Casting again refreshes all bonuses if the previous skill was a different Element.

1227278.flavor: "Can you not hear it? That endless scream from the cold earth beneath your feet!? They are down there, trapped, blind with rage! Waiting to drag us down into the sod!" -Ravings of Madman Gustav
1227278.name: Gloves_Unique_Necro_100
1227278.power: Instead of detonating immediately, Corpse Explosion now Summons a Volatile Skeleton that charges at a random enemy and explodes. Corpse Explosion deals 70-90% increased damage.

1230485.flavor: Once a sanctum for Rathma's studies, the Temple of the Deathspeaker became a proving grounds for potential leaders of his priesthood. Its halls are filled with the corpses of those who failed.
1230485.name: Amulet_Unique_Necro_100
1230485.power: Blood Surge casts a mini nova on your Minions, dealing # damage. Damage is increased by 10% per target drained by the initial cast, up to 50%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Core Blood Surge Higher
Resource On Hit Necro Blood Surge

1234671.flavor: "Rathma is endless. He was the first Ancient, and will remain at the end. He is the master of the Great Cycle of Being. When Death comes for him, why should he fear it?" -Vauntus, Acolyte of Rathma
1234671.name: Helm_Unique_Necro_100
1234671.power: Critical Strikes with Bone Spear form an echo that bursts, dealing 0.6-0.7% of its normal damage. Bone Spear deals 60-70% increased Critical Strike Damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Core Bone Spear

1275935.flavor: "Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe." - Last words of Master Selig
1275935.name: Amulet_Unique_Generic_100
1275935.power: Damage is dealt to your Primary Resource before Life and damage taken this way is drastically reduced. Your Primary Resource is doubled but Maximum Life is reduced by 75%.

1304378.flavor: Harrogath, the final bastion of resistance against Baal's assault on Mt. Arreat was destroyed along with the Worldstone. The survivors never forgave the betrayal that led to the loss of their home.
1304378.name: Chest_Unique_Barb_100
1304378.power: Inflicting Damage Over Time on an enemy has up to a 45-60% chance to reduce the Cooldowns of your Skills by 0.5 |4second:seconds;.

1304456.flavor: "Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day." - Sorrowsong for Ramaladni
1304456.name: 1HSword_Unique_Barb_101
1304456.power: Skills deal 0.35-0.5% increased damage per point of Fury you have, but 7% Fury Drains per second while in combat.

1304469.flavor: "The change that overtook my brother in battle was terrifying. His eyes turned hard like diamonds, and the way he moved... it was like he was dancing to music only he could hear." - Captain Dervin
1304469.name: Amulet_Unique_Barb_100
1304469.power: Frenzy gains the Barrage Variant for free and can stack 2 additional times. While at maximum stacks, you deal 50-66.66% increased damage and your other Skills gain 23.33-30% increased Attack Speed.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Basic Frenzy

1304490.flavor: "Listen, child, to the music of the storm. It has its own rhythm. Its own melody. Hear how beautifully it sings, and perhaps one day you will be able to join in its harmony." – Airidah
1304490.name: Helm_Unique_Druid_100

1306214.flavor: "Roots from the Great Oak growing at the seaward statue of Vasily will, on rare occasions, be found twisted back upon themselves, suffused with ferocious magic." - Barrett's Book of Implements
1306214.name: Helm_Unique_Druid_101

1306219.flavor: The nights preceding the full moon are sometimes far more dangerous than the event itself. The frenzy has begun to rise, yet the night is just dark enough to obscure a hunter from their prey's sight.
1306219.name: 1HAxe_Unique_Druid_100
1306219.power: Shred deals 45-60% more damage, and Shred has a 33% chance to land an additional strike, up to 4 times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Core Shred

1306230.flavor: "The infamous Necromancer Gaza-Thul's mastery over blood magic was indisputable. Many suspect that upon his death, his skin was used to fashion this eldritch armor." -Barrett's Book of Implements
1306230.name: Chest_Unique_Necro_101
1306230.power: When you pick up # Blood Orbs, a free Bone Spirit is spawned, dealing bonus damage based on your current Life percent.
stats: Resource After Skill Necro Blood Orb
Skill Rank Bonus Necro Special Bone Spirit

1306236.flavor: "The scrolls describe a river of tar that separated the living from the land of the dead. Any unfortunate soul who tried to cross would be dragged down into oblivion." -Notes of Scholar Kamien
1306236.name: 1HScythe_Unique_Necro_100
1306236.power: Corpse Explosion consumes up to 4 additional Corpses around the initial Corpse, gaining 120-160% damage and 42-50% Size per additional Corpse consumed.
stats: Double Damage Skill Necro Corpse Explosion
Skill Rank Bonus Necro Category Corpse Higher

1306251.flavor: Dark wisps creep hungrily across these gloves, like an assassin's blade seeking a life to steal on a moonless night.
1306251.name: Gloves_Unique_Rogue_100
1306251.power: Casting a Marksman or Cutthroat Skill has a 45-60% chance to Summon a Shadow Clone that mimics that Skill.

1306259.flavor: "Let the great gates of Caldeum be sealed. Let its proud walls stand fiercely defended. The rest of Kehjistan may suffer this plague, but my city, and my people, will not." - Proclamation of Hakan II
1306259.name: Amulet_Unique_Rogue_100
1306259.power: Your Rain of Arrows is always Imbued with all Imbuements and deals 75-90% increased damage to Distant enemies.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Category Imbuements

1306274.flavor: The mad artisan saw his fingers turn black from frostbite as he worked the cloth, but refused to stay the needle and thread for even a moment.
1306274.name: Pants_Unique_Sorc_100
1306274.power: Your Conjurations periodically unleash Frost Nova. Enemies affected by Frost Nova take 20-30% increased damage from you.

1306302.flavor: "While scholars have proven these boots were not created by Esu herself, it is noteworthy that they have been passed down since the formation of the Mage Clans." - Barrett's Book of Implements
1306302.name: Boots_Unique_Sorc_100
1306302.power: Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by 20-40% of your Movement Speed bonus. Current Bonus: #%

1306311.flavor: "Also known as the Greatstaff of the Old Religion, this powerful relic is one of only a small handful of Skatsimi artifacts that have survived to this day." - Barrett's Book of Implements
1306311.name: 2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_100
1306311.power: Charged Bolts deal 55-80% increased damage, last 300% longer and seek enemies.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 4 Charged Bolts

1306326.flavor: "The revelation that master tailor Callas was in fact a witch only served to further fuel the desire for her uniquely enchanted legwraps." - Barrett's Book of Implements
1306326.name: Pants_Unique_Generic_100
1306326.power: Effects that Heal you beyond 100% Life grant you Barrier equal to 80-100% of the overhealed amount that lasts for 8 seconds. You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.

1306338.flavor: "Yours is the power to pluck the stars from the heavens with the ease of a child gathering fruit from the bough." - Unknown
1306338.name: Ring_Unique_Generic_101
1306338.power: Spending your Primary Resource reduces the Resource cost of your Skills and increases your damage by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 50%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

1433955.flavor: "The storm caller returns, day after day, demanding to meet the Tree. He beats his chest and demonstrates his powers, refusing to believe that he will never be chosen." - Excerpt from Gulyas' Diary
1433955.name: Gloves_Unique_Druid_100
1433955.power: Lightning Storm gains 1 additional strike each time it grows and deals 20-25% bonus damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Core Lightning Storm

1439530.flavor: "The rhythm of the orb, which had pulsed steadily for five centuries, quickened as its owner took his final ragged breaths. It were as if some intelligence within reveled in the sight." - Master Eos
1439530.name: 1HWand_Unique_Sorc_101
1439530.power: Each enemy hit by Teleport increases the damage by 10-15% and reduces the Cooldown by 0.5 of the next Cast. Becoming Injured will Teleport you to a random location.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Teleport

1439538.flavor: "Scholars have been unable to decipher the runes carved into this bow, however all agree they are related to its uncanny ability to bend arrows towards their targets." - Barrett's Book of Implements
1439538.name: 2HBow_Unique_Rogue_100
1439538.power: Penetrating Shot bounces off walls and deals 60-75% more damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Core Penetrating Shot

1439542.flavor: Initially an unpopular choice to replace Mendeln as Deathspeaker, Daros quickly proved his worth with the creation of this masterpiece.
1439542.name: 1HShield_Unique_Necro_100
1439542.power: Lucky Hit: While you have an active Bone Storm, hitting an enemy has up to a 35-45% chance to spawn a Bone Storm around their location. Each Sacrifice bonus increases this chance by 25% and allows you to spawn 1 additional Bone Storm. Each active Bone Storm grants 30% Critical Strike Damage, up to 150%.

1477080.flavor: “May the Light of Father Inarius shine down upon all weary travelers of this holy land. Turn your face toward his radiance and find your strength renewed.” - Statue Inscription
1477080.name: Pants_Unique_Generic_101
1477080.power: When you take damage from a Non-Physical damage type, you gain 130-160% Resistance to that damage type for 6 seconds. This effect can only apply to one damage type at a time.

1489566.flavor: As he fought with side by side with Raekor to liberate the labor camp, Joritz claimed this dented helm from a fallen foe. As his legend grew, its unique shape became synonymous with his great deeds.
1489566.name: Helm_Unique_Barb_100
1489566.power: When you gain Berserking while already Berserk, you become more enraged granting 40-50% increased damage, 6 Fury per second, and 10% Cooldown Reduction.

1555195.flavor: "The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all." - Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast
1555195.name: Helm_Unique_Generic_003
1555195.power: When you attempt to Incapacitate an enemy, you mark them and all surrounding enemies, pulling them in and dealing 7.5-10% increased damage to them.

1559325.flavor: Crafted from fragments of Duriel's carapace, wearing these gloves, or being struck by them, causes an agonizing sensation akin to pushing one's hands through a thousand shards of glass.
1559325.name: Gloves_Unique_Generic_004
1559325.power: Damaging enemies with a Non-Basic Skill cast marks them for 3 seconds. When a Basic Skill first hits a marked enemy, the Basic Skill's damage is echoed to all marked enemies, dealing 100-125% increased damage.

1559419.flavor: "The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing." - Crusader Pembroke
1559419.name: Pants_Unique_Generic_102
1559419.power: You deal 15-20% increased damage and gain 25 Primary Resource Regeneration while Unstoppable and for 5 seconds after.

1559921.flavor: Skulking in the shadows of the Realm of Destruction, the Scarred Baron plots the downfall of the mortal who banished him there.
1559921.name: Ring_Unique_Generic_102
1559921.power: Each Damage over Time type you apply explodes every second, dealing # damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies.

1560871.flavor: "To create such an artifact would require an impossible mastery over alchemy, transmutation and the subtle magics of the soul. By all rights, it should not exist, yet it does." - Artisan Callas
1560871.name: Chest_Unique_Generic_101
1560871.power: Your Healing Potions grant a Barrier for 100% of your Maximum Life for 1 second. You gain 25-30% Damage Reduction while you have a Barrier and may drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.

1561308.flavor: "His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved." - Scholar's Notes
1561308.name: Amulet_Unique_Generic_101
1561308.power: After you spend 275 of your Primary Resource, gain 4 stacks of Overpower. Consuming Overpower increases your Critical Strikes damage by 86.67-100% for 8 seconds.

1610441.flavor: As the hateful mob beat on his door, he gripped the pulsing shard tightly and screamed for calm. When he opened his eyes, all that greeted him was silence and the blood-smeared ruins of his cottage.
1610441.name: Amulet_Unique_Druid_100
1610441.power: Boulder deals 75-90% increased damage and explodes when it expires.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Boulder

1612292.flavor: "Rumor has it he lost them in a game of Skull & Anchor, but the boss is a devil with the dice. I think he wanted to give the poor sod something to keep him warm without wounding his pride." - Elstir
1612292.name: Chest_Unique_Rogue_100
1612292.power: Your Trap Skills can be thrown and deal 45-60% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Category Trap

1704785.flavor: "Genai grew proud and fond of boasting of her hunting prowess. She claimed she was fast enough to catch even the spirit Leraye, who cursed her for such an insult." - Fable of Genai's Twenty Trials
1704785.name: Boots_Unique_Rogue_100
1704785.power: When you Cast a non-Channeled Ultimate Skill, it Consumes all of your Energy and deals 0.6-0.75% increased damage per Energy Consumed. Using a Cooldown restores 25 Energy.

1706602.flavor: "Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always." - Talic, to Madawc
1706602.name: Ring_Unique_Barb_100
1706602.power: After spending 30 Fury within 5 seconds, your next non-Channeled Core or Weapon Mastery Skill Cast within 5 seconds is a guaranteed Critical Strike and deals 50-60% bonus Critical Strike Damage. Excess Fury grants 1% additional bonus.

1706651.flavor: "When I was born, I breathed in the wind and the storm and they gave me life. When I die, I will breath out, and return that gift to the skies." - Journal excerpt
1706651.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_100
1706651.power: Storm Strike chains to twice as many targets and gains 30-45% bonus damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Basic Storm Strike

1706658.flavor: The ring shifts and spins on your finger as the forces within desperately attempt to escape.
1706658.name: Ring_Unique_Rogue_100
1706658.power: Your Subterfuge Skills create a Decoy Trap that Taunts and lures enemies, dealing # Corrupting damage over 6 seconds. This counts as a Trap Skill and only one Decoy can be active at a time.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Category Trap

1706660.flavor: The mere proximity of a practitioner of such dark arts can rouse the dead and disturb those souls who have earned their rest.
1706660.name: Ring_Unique_Necro_101
1706660.power: Corpse Tendrils gains the effect of every Upgrade and is automatically triggered once every 16 seconds. This timer is reduced by 1.5-2 seconds each second while there are corpses by you.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Special Corpse Tendrils

1712702.flavor: "The hunger, it starts so small, like a tickle in the back of your mind. You believe the lie that you still have control until you're so far gone you can't even recognize yourself." -Varyana
1712702.name: Ring_Unique_Barb_101
1712702.power: Rend's duration is increased by 6-8 seconds and deals 60-80% increased damage. Damaging enemies with your Brawling Skills applies 1 |4stack:stacks; of Rend's Bleed. This can only affect each enemy once every 0.5 |4second:seconds;.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Core Rend

1713218.flavor: "The elders say they saw a star falling from the sky many years ago. A sign from the heavens that the end times were nigh. A rallying cry to take up arms and protect Sanctuary!" - Crusader Hamilton
1713218.name: Helm_Unique_Sorc_100
1713218.power: Meteor Casts consume Overpower when possible, dropping an additional Meteor for every 2 Overpower consumed. Meteor deals 80-100% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Meteor

1719158.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights
1719158.name: Amulet_Unique_Generic_102
1719158.power: You are always Berserking but take 200% increased damage as Burning over 8 seconds. While Burning, Berserking grants an additional 80-100% increased damage.

1758459.flavor: "Ploughin' told you already! Hidden weapons are out – Yes, especially grenades! Behave yourself, or Morrick will skin you lot."- Purveyor of the Gea Kul fighting pits, on the eve of Morrick's murder
1758459.name: x1_Ring_Unique_Rogue_128
1758459.power: Smoke Grenade bounces and detonates a second time. Smoke Grenade's damage is increased by 15-20% and Duration is increased by 7.5-10%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Smoke Bomb

1788901.flavor: "Ah, Burning Hells. You look like one of Zolmog's inbred bastards." -Varyana
1788901.name: Helm_Unique_Barb_101_x1
1788901.power: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, you deal 45-60% increased Fire damage.

1858740.flavor: These greaves are imbued with the divine blessing of Yen, the Veradani goddess of restoration. They bestow the wearer a revitalizing strength that enhances their own.
1858740.name: Boots_Unique_Generic_003
1858740.power: Casting a Skill has a 40-60% chance to trigger a Non-Mobility, Non-Ultimate Skill that is currently on Cooldown. Can only occur once every 8 seconds.

1862757.flavor: Winterglass refracts light and also manipulates mana - forming complex arrays of spells and enchantments. These distinct characteristics possess great power, yet the outcomes remain unpredictable.
1862757.name: Amulet_Unique_Sorc_101
1862757.power: Casting a Core Skill has a 25% chance to summon a Conjuration of the same element. Each active Conjuration grants: #% increased damage 1 Mana per second 5% Movement Speed 2.5% Damage Reduction
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Category Conjuration

1881284.flavor: When Arreat was sundered, the world quaked. The Druid Aglainn journeyed far to chronicle the aftermath. Grief-stricken by the great mountain king's fall, he rent the earth anew.
1881284.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_101
1881284.power: Casts of Landslide leave behind Tectonic Spikes that deal # Physical damage over 2 seconds. Spawning a Landslide pillar within Tectonic Spikes has a 50-60% chance to spawn two instead.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Core Landslide

1895711.flavor: Driven to surpass Esu, the wizard Naridan's reckless enchantments caused an inferno, devastating the ancient town of Cagrim. Only the gauntlets remained - a solemn warning to all who dare tame fire.
1895711.name: Gloves_Unique_Sorc_101
1895711.power: Casting Fire Bolt through your Firewall causes it to split into 3 bolts, each dealing 80-100% increased damage.

1901484.flavor: "Thus Tyrael, a perfect aspect of Justice, came to be. None were more vehement against the forces of hell. All demonic entities learned to shudder at Justice's might." -The Books of Jarl, Volume I
1901484.name: Chest_Unique_Generic_127
1901484.power: Gain 20% Damage Reduction. While at full Life, your Skills unleash a divine barrage dealing # damage.

1901740.flavor: "Rise clansmen and reclaim our trampled honor! Ancients' blood runs through us all! We are storms: earth breaking, maelstrom wielding. The fire of the gods burn still! They are with us!" -Ealda
1901740.name: Pants_Unique_Barb_100
1901740.power: Your non-Ultimate Skills that summon Ancients will now summon an additional one. Skills that summon Ancients deal 30-40% increased damage.

1901746.flavor: "When hitting it once doesn't kill it, hit it twice." -Bear Tribe Proverb
1901746.name: Gloves_Unique_Barb_100
1901746.power: Double Swing's initial sweep deals 45-60% increased damage and applies Vulnerable. Subsequent swings deals 90-120% increased damage and grants Berserking for 3 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Core Double Swing

1902139.flavor: Do not seek comfort in the shapes of the moon, beastwalker. Its pallid light awakens a yawning hunger. Call the beast, but do not tarry. Lest you never return to your own skin.
1902139.name: Boots_Unique_Druid_100
1902139.power: Rabies spreads 100% faster and deals 10% bonus damage (max 120-150%) each time it spreads. Bosses take maximum bonus damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Rabies

1902155.flavor: In the blood dancer's grasp, a victim lies, A vessel dried 'neath darkened skies. Their life extinguished, veins burst and drained, In Cruor's embrace, forever enchained.
1902155.name: Gloves_Unique_Necro_101
1902155.power: Casting Blood Surge picks up 4 Blood Orbs around you to expel smaller blood novas, dealing 80-100% of normal damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Core Blood Surge

1902313.name: Ring_Unique_Rogue_101
1902313.power: Gain 1 Ferocity every 2 seconds as long as no enemies are Close to you. Your Marksman Skills deal 12-15% increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

1902469.flavor: This talisman was the life's work of Deathspeaker Jurdann. Following his premature demise, Jurdann's successor wore the amulet in tribute as they trialed against the Temple of the Deathspeaker.
1902469.name: Amulet_Unique_Necro_101
1902469.power: Blight also shoots 4 smaller piercing projectiles, each dealing 40-46.67% of Blight's defiled area damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Core Blight

1903128.flavor: "The element of surprise is the starting point. In this moment, be sure to finish it." - Kashya
1903128.name: Ring_Unique_Rogue_102
1903128.power: Your Grenades gain 50% increased Size and deal 75-90% increased damage. Enemies damaged by Grenade Skills become either Vulnerable or Weakened for 4 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Grenade

1934408.flavor: After the warmaster Raekor freed her people, the Oxen tribe continued to wear their collars and chains to honor those who died in thralldom under the Samauren Empire.
1934408.name: Amulet_Unique_Barb_101
1934408.power: Swapping weapons increases the damage of Iron Maelstrom by 25-30% for 5 |4second:seconds;, stacking up to 3 times.

1934437.flavor: "In fairer times, the Emperor gifted Prince Aidan a gilded shroud. Still a boy, not yet full height, it dwarfed poor Aidan. Briefly, Leoric's growing madness abated from laughter." -Deckard Cain
1934437.name: Chest_Unique_Rogue_101
1934437.power: Casting Dark Shroud makes you Immune for 2 seconds, but your Evade Cooldown is increased by 3 seconds. Evading while Dark Shroud is active leaves behind an explosion that deals # Shadow damage and Pulls In enemies.

1934441.flavor: "Essence flows endlessly, shifting between vessels. It is through Trag'Oul, keeper of all known and unknown, that we serve as custodians, directing essence to travel new paths." -Mendeln ul-Diomed
1934441.name: Boots_Unique_Necro_101
1934441.power: Bone Prison traps a larger area and fires 30-35 Bone Splinters at enemies trapped within. Your Maximum Essence is increased by 2 for 10 seconds each time these Bone Splinters hit an enemy.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Special Bone Prison

1934445.flavor: "Do not confuse your manipulation of lightning as control. The azure flame is its own master and needs no hand to wield it. You are merely a conduit for its chaos." -Ascribed to the mage Woh
1934445.name: Pants_Unique_Sorc_101
1934445.power: Casting Chain Lightning has a 50% chance to activate 1 to 2-5 additional times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 3 Chain Lightning

1944386.flavor: Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.
1944386.name: S05_BSK_Gloves_Unique_Generic_001
1944386.power: When you would be damaged for at least 30% of your Maximum Life at once, it is instead distributed over the next 4 seconds and reduced by 15-20%.

1944475.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.
1944475.name: S05_BSK_Helm_Unique_Generic_001
1944475.power: Each time you use a Skill with a Primary Resource Cost, gain 5-7.5% increased damage and Resource Cost is increased by 30% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times.
stats: Resource Cost Reduction All Classes Lesser

1944491.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.
1944491.name: S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001
1944491.power: Basic Skills deal 70-100% increased damage but additionally cost 25 Primary Resource.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Basic

1944504.flavor: Tread carefully on the plains of Hell, for each step sunders the soul and shatters the mind.
1944504.name: S05_BSK_Boots_Unique_Generic_001
1944504.power: When you cast a Skill with a Cooldown, you explode, dealing # Fire damage.

1944508.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.
1944508.name: S05_BSK_Amulet_Unique_Generic_001
1944508.power: Critical Strikes deal 80-100% increased damage but your Critical Strike Chance is reduced by 50%.

1944513.flavor: Your incantations are echoed by a chorus of the damned. Wield their torment, their vengeance, their pain against the Hellborne that tortured them.
1944513.name: S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Sorcerer_001
1944513.power: Casting a Core Skill triggers a random equipped Basic Skill at a random enemy which deals #% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Basic

1944530.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer
1944530.name: S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Barbarian_001
1944530.power: Your Weapon Mastery Skills are now also Core Skills that have 100% Cooldown Reduction but cost Fury, dealing 140-160% of normal damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

1944544.flavor: "Well did she feed her children, and well did her children feed her." -Scosglen folktale
1944544.name: S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001
1944544.power: Petrified enemies have a #% increased chance to be Critically Struck and take #% increased damage. Additionally, Earth Skills Petrify Healthy enemies for 3 seconds.

1944555.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.
1944555.name: S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001
1944555.power: Your Subterfuge Skills create an attackable Shade Totem for 6-8 seconds. Any damage it takes is replicated onto surrounding enemies at 50% effectiveness. This effect is treated as a Trap Skill. You may only have 1 |4Shade Totem:Shade Totems; active at a time.

1944574.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.
1944574.name: S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Necro_001
1944574.power: When consuming a Corpse, there is a 40-50% chance to also create a decaying Skeletal Simulacrum that seeks enemies but cannot attack. When it dies, it explodes for # Shadow damage. This effect is treated as a Macabre Skill.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Category Macabre

1952218.name: Gloves_Unique_Druid_95
1952218.power: Lightning Storm gains 1 additional strike each time it grows and deals 20-25% bonus damage.

1963851.name: Template_Unique_Spiritborn_000_x1
1963851.power: (PH) Skill has 10-15% random rolled Stat against enemies with 4 static Stat and Keyword.
stats: Damage Type Bonus Non Physical Greater

1966407.flavor: The inner curve of this band is lined with thorns that tear the skin whenever it is unbound.
1966407.name: Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_001_x1
1966407.power: Every time you deal Thorns damage, you gain 7-10 Vigor. Gain Toxic Skin's Passive Effect.

1966411.flavor: "Within this corpse-bound carapace we writhe. Chaotic winds converge to churn your bones. Our beat and breath a ceaseless war to break. The wretched cyclone black beyond the bounds." - Balazan's Dream
1966411.name: Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_002_x1
1966411.power: A Pestilent Swarm spawns from you every 4 seconds, dealing # Poison damage per hit. Your Pestilent Swarms now orbit around you and reduce an equipped Eagle Skill's cooldown by 0.25 seconds per hit.

1966414.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.
1966414.name: Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_003_x1
1966414.power: Casting Evade consumes 1 |4stack:stacks; of Resolve to increase your damage dealt by 50-60% for 5 seconds. Gain Armored Hide's Passive Effect.

1966457.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture
1966457.name: Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_004_x1
1966457.power: While you have at least 4 stacks of Ferocity, you gain 15-20% increased damage and 60-80% increased Armor. Gaining Ferocity also grants Resolve.

1966459.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV
1966459.name: Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_005_x1
1966459.power: Your Maximum Vigor is increased by 50%, and killing an enemy grants you 7-10 Vigor. While you have Ferocity, your new Poisoning effects last 33% longer.

1966461.flavor: "At midnight laughed the second brother, Nebahayomo, spirit of cunning. Trickery is his blessing, suffering is his prayer. Honor him and shrewdness shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse V
1966461.name: Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_006_x1
1966461.power: When you Critically Strike, you regain 40-50% of the Vigor you've spent in the last 2 seconds. Gain Counterattack's Passive Effect.

1968318.flavor: "Sky Spirits weave the winds. Thunder is their laughter and auroras their crowns. Those they bless learn to scorn the earth, for from above, it is but a distant memory." - Lintel VII
1968318.name: Boots_Unique_Spiritborn_008_x1
1968318.power: Your Evade is now Soar. Soar deals 125-150% increased damage and triggers Vortex at its landing location
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Spiritborn Special Soar

1968430.flavor: T'an seized a spear and drove it thrice into his mad brother Tan. Alas, the craftier of the twin gods wove one last cunning snare. In place of blood, the wound wept venom and consumed all in its wake.
1968430.name: Gloves_Unique_Spiritborn_007_x1
1968430.power: Direct damage is distributed as Poisoning over the next 10 seconds and reduced by 10-15%. Lucky Hit: Direct damage has up to a 25% chance based on your Poisoned Life percentage to infect an enemy with Touch of Death.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Spiritborn Special Touch Of Death

1969787.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.
1969787.name: Chest_Unique_Spiritborn_013_x1
1969787.power: Spending Vigor Heals you for 7-10% of your Maximum Life. Every second, your active Cooldowns each drain 10% Maximum Life from you to reduce their durations by 2 seconds.

1982241.flavor: In the days when Ajaw Y'ishich ruled Nahantu, the phoenix constellation's crown fell in burning glory. From it was forged a blade that withered valor, heralding an age of despair.
1982241.name: Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_014_x1
1982241.power: Every 2 seconds, you randomly mark a Nearby enemy. Marked enemies are Vulnerable, and your attacks against them are guaranteed to Critically Strike. Hitting a marked enemy 10 times clears the mark from them.

1987312.flavor: To the silent skies, the hunter Etzlek raised his staff and then smote the numen. "Release her!" came his cries as he desecrated the hallowed ground. On the third strike, the spirit answered...
1987312.name: Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_012_x1
1987312.power: Your Basic Skills deal 90-110% increased damage and always use their 3rd attack. Every 3rd cast of a Basic Skill strikes three times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Basic

1987546.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.
1987546.name: Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_009_x1
1987546.power: According to your secondary Spirit Hall choice, your Skills are all additionally Jaguar, Eagle, Gorilla, or Centipede Skills. Your Skills deal 25-30% increased damage per Spirit type they have.

1990382.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.
1990382.name: Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_011_x1
1990382.power: While your Spirit Hall choices match: Their bonuses are 100% more potent. Skills of their Base Spirit gain 50-60% Vigor Cost Reduction. Skills of their Base Spirit gain 50-60% Cooldown Reduction.

2012497.flavor: "Fear not the limits of your flesh, Spiritborn! As our ancestors said: wushe nak pa! Transcend your being!" - Maka
2012497.name: Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_010_x1
2012497.power: Casting an Ultimate Skill grants or amplifies its matching Primary Spirit Hall Bonus with #% potency for 15 seconds. Your Ultimate Skills each gain an additional Skill Type: The Seeker is a Focus Skill. The Hunter is a Mobility Skill. The Devourer is a Potency Skill. The Protector is a Defensive Skill.

2016139.flavor: A singed wedding band, faintly crackling. It evokes an old rhyme where a bride receives a ring from her beloved, causing them to be struck thrice by lightning. Only the bride was unscathed.
2016139.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_102
2016139.power: While Cataclysm is active, you gain unlimited Spirit and deal 45-60% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Category Nature Magic

2020163.flavor: "To commune with spirits, listen to whispers unseen. Root yourself unto the earth and let its pulse still the mind. Hear the ancient guardians – they rise to aid you." -Ysevete, the First Spiritborn
2020163.name: Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_015_x1
2020163.power: While moving, you gain 25-30% Dodge Chance and Damage Reduction. After standing still for 2 seconds, you become Unstoppable until you move.

2024115.flavor: "A relic of an old, forgotten religion lost to time and expansion. The staff retains a faint warmth as if still blessed by the dead god it once served." - Ser Paget's notes from the Tiklan excavation
2024115.name: Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_001
2024115.power: Your Focus Skills benefit from all their Upgrades, and they increase the damage of your Potency Skills by 30-35% for 8 seconds, up to 150-175%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Spiritborn Category Potency

2043555.flavor: Long ago, the Stone Clan laid the foundations of Old Kurast. They shaped earthen marvels, but wars with the Vizjerei turned chisel into spear. Now the only stone they wield is when cast against foe.
2043555.name: Totem_Unique_Druid_101_x1
2043555.power: Gain 40% to All Resistances while channeling Stone Burst. Stone Burst's final explosion deals 250-300% bonus damage split between all targets caught in the blast.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Core Stone Burst

2044974.flavor: "Changing, consuming, becoming: this is the way of all life. I give myself to you, my children, so that you may live." Low of Bo'a, Verse 112-113
2044974.name: Boots_Unique_Sorc_96
2044974.power: Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by 20-40% of your Movement Speed bonus. Current Bonus: #%

2044976.flavor: The leather feels warm to the touch, as through life clings to it. A divine purpose still trembles in each fold.
2044976.name: Chest_Unique_Sorc_96
2044976.power: Teleport pulls Close enemies to you and you gain 40-50 Damage Reduction for 8 seconds.

2044978.flavor: "Kin of Bo'a, beloved of Bucrani, Whose path led into the wine-dark pasture. The victor's sword swings for this alone, To lop off all thought and memory–a final mercy." Low of Bo'a, Verse 50-54
2044978.name: Gloves_Unique_Sorc_96
2044978.power: Casting Fire Bolt through your Firewall causes it to split into 3 bolts, each dealing 80-100% increased damage.

2044982.flavor: "...In those days, the children of Bucrani were known to many. Great was their sway, and mighty was their squall! How could any realm hold such strong souls?" -Oxridge, Common Histories, fragment II
2044982.name: Pants_Unique_Sorc_96
2044982.power: Casting Chain Lightning has a 50% chance to activate 1 to 2-5 additional times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 3 Chain Lightning

2049847.flavor: "While known for their proclivity for mischief, the Sidhe, as the Druids call them, are fiercely loyal and will defend all they consider friend..." - Sarnakyle
2049847.name: Gloves_Unique_Sorc_143_x1
2049847.power: Gain Familiar's Enchantment and Familiar's Potency is increased by 60-80%.

2053186.flavor: Urzael rent asunder his own wings and armor with a fury unbridled. For never would he bow to the doom of mortals, nor endure defeat at their lowly hands.
2053186.name: Helm_Unique_Necro_101_x1
2053186.power: Soulrift's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds for every 30 Essence you spend while it's active, up to 8 seconds. Soulrift deals 300-350% of its Shadow damage per second to surrounding enemies for every 30 Essence you gain while it's active.

2059799.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.
2059799.name: Helm_Unique_Generic_004
2059799.power: Succumb to hatred and earn Mother's Favor. Slaughtering enemies briefly steals 15% Critical Strike Chance from surrounding allies with Mother's Favor. Mother's Favor always grants you 15% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2059803.flavor: "Auriel alone saw past Lucion's guise. With Al'maiesh aloft, she smote the vile prince. Hatred's seed feigned death and waited, loath to enter the Abyss again." - The Great Conflict, Tome I
2059803.name: Chest_Unique_Generic_103
2059803.power: When you would be dealt fatal damage, instead you Heal to full Life, gain a Barrier for 100% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds, and Knock Back Close enemies. This power is disabled once used until you return to town.

2059805.flavor: Break their bones beneath your weight, Fell their walls and breach their gate. In his halls we'll boast and sing, And praise our honored mountain king!
2059805.name: Boots_Unique_Barb_101
2059805.power: Casting a Basic Skill while at Maximum Fury causes your Fury to increasingly Drain until you run out, during which your Basic skills now cleave dealing 45-60% increased damage.

2059808.flavor: A relic of Yorin's ill-starred tempering. Regardless of success, Donan proudly displayed them all upon the mantelpiece... in fairer days.
2059808.name: Gloves_Unique_Rogue_101
2059808.power: This item is worthless as its power has been lost.
stats: Damage Type Bonus Non Physical Higher
Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Core Flurry

2059813.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.
2059813.name: 2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001
2059813.power: Enemies afflicted by more Damage over Time than remaining Life are Executed.

2081122.flavor: Before Baal's hosts blighted Daken-Shar, the outnumbered northmen clad themselves in barbed mail so that even in death, the demons still bled.
2081122.name: Gloves_Unique_Barb_101
2081122.power: While channeling Whirlwind, you now periodically hurl out a Mighty Throw that deals 75-90% increased damage.

2081129.flavor: 'Twas Gathlen, most tender warden of the elder realm, who reigneth o'er grove and glade. Whosoever he favors shall inherit the wilds. Utter his name, and be embraced.
2081129.name: Helm_Unique_Druid_102
2081129.power: Cyclone Armor is automatically triggered once every 5 seconds. Gain Cyclone Armor's passive and it grants you 20-30% Damage Reduction if you are Human.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Cyclone Armor

2081131.flavor: "What you feel is the Ancients high on the mountain, my son. When they stomp their feet, the earth trembles! But fear not—it's our enemies they mean to warn." -Chieftess Naarah
2081131.name: Chest_Unique_Barb_101
2081131.power: Casting Hammer of the Ancients on an Earthquake explodes for their total damage and are consumed, and also causes your Hammer of the Ancients to deal 60-80% increased damage for 5 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Special Earthquake

2081135.flavor: "Túr Dúlra sat empty and the Cathedral sent forth two units. The full moon was thought to be a fair omen from the Heavens. They soon learned what else drew from its power." - History of Scosglen VI
2081135.name: Amulet_Unique_Druid_101
2081135.power: Blood Howl is automatically cast when you Shapeshift into a Werewolf and every 4 seconds while in Werewolf form. In addition, you gain 26.67-40% bonus damage for 4 seconds whenever Blood Howl is triggered.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Blood Howl

2081141.flavor: The height of the Moon Clan's power brought a beast that instilled dread upon Khanduras. More demon than Khazra, the one dubbed the Stormhorn left charred brands where cities once stood.
2081141.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_100
2081141.power: Ball Lightning deals 40-60% increased damage and explodes for 40% of its total damage when dissipating.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Ball Lightning

2081143.flavor: "Ere the age of mage and king, storms raged so dread and fell that men named it the wrath of gods. Its hail smote the earth till mountains were wrought..." -Tome recovered from Kasama
2081143.name: Helm_Unique_Sorc_101
2081143.power: Gain Ice Shards' Piercing Cold upgrade. Ice Shards deals 30-50% bonus damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 2 Ice Shards

2081153.flavor: "Too soon she was taken, yet Rathma let Kessime rest in death, for they both had found peace in the cycle. Upon the hill where she lay, Rathma poured forth his blood and no evil trod thereafter..."
2081153.name: Pants_Unique_Necro_101
2081153.power: Blood Wave now forms a wave on each side of you. Both waves converge at your feet, Pulling In all surrounding enemies and exploding for # damage.

2081159.flavor: The parched blade keens, longing to serve its master.
2081159.name: 2HSword_Unique_Necro_100
2081159.power: Your Summons' damage afflict enemies with Vampiric Curse. Consuming a Corpse also contributes 3 souls to Vampiric Curse, which can now stack up to 20 souls. Only Army of the Dead can now unleash the souls from Vampiric Curse, causing both Army of the Dead and the souls to deal 20-25% increased damage per soul unleashed.

2081162.flavor: The Viz-Jaq'taar descended on the mages indiscriminately and silently as a plague. The wise took flight, whilst the foolish fortified their dwellings as if walls or wards protected from shadow.
2081162.name: Boots_Unique_Rogue_101
2081162.power: Mobility Skills are always Shadow Imbued with 45-60% increased potency. Lucky Hit: Damaging an Elite or Boss with a Mobility Skill has up to a 45-60% chance to instantly trigger a free Shadow Imbuement explosion.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Shadow Imbue

2081193.flavor: Long ago, the Sunbird swallowed the sun whole. In the dark, the Spiritborn Xipil crawled to its nest and tore the sun free from the bird's gullet. Since, its throat was scorched red for its folly.
2081193.name: Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_100
2081193.power: Picking up a Storm Feather forms a firestorm around you for 12 seconds dealing # Fire damage every 0.5 seconds. Every 5 additional Storm Feathers you pick up intensifies the firestorm, increasing its damage by 100% but not refreshing its duration. Storm Feathers are now Jaguar Skills and the firestorm is an Eagle, Jaguar, and Storm Feather Skill.

2093166.flavor: "Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII
2093166.name: Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_016_x1
2093166.power: Your Core Skills are now additionally Basic Skills and free to cast. When cast at Maximum Vigor, your Core Skills Consume all Vigor to cast at their largest Size, and become guaranteed Critical Strikes, with 0.5-0.6% increased Critical Strike Damage for each point of Vigor spent this way.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2123318.flavor: "The tears of Linarian turned bloody over Indira's torn body. Many days, unyielding, he poured his magic into sundered bone and rended sinew. Though the flesh did mend, his beloved did not rise..."
2123318.name: Pants_Unique_Necro_102
2123318.power: Blood Wave is additionally a Bone Skill. It spawns a Bone Prison at its end point and increases your Blood Skill damage by 20-40% for 8 seconds when Cast. All Bone Spears are additionally Blood Skills. Your Bone Spears consume a Corpse to launch another Bone Spear and drain 10% of your Maximum Life.

2134748.flavor: "Children and beast do tremble at thunder's roar, but the wise know to fear the silence of lightning." - Okun, of the Zann Esu
2134748.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_101
2134748.power: (PH) I need a new design! (Ball Lightning)
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Ball Lightning

2185046.flavor: The Philios Games were said to welcome the prideful, the reckless, and the condemned.
2185046.name: Gloves_Unique_Rogue_98
2185046.power: The first direct damage you deal to an enemy is a guaranteed Critical Strike. When a Marksman Skill first Critically Strikes, it gains 90-120% increased damage, and you gain 1 Overpower. This can stack up to 4 over your Maximum Overpower.

2242286.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left - stone, silver, and sanctified relics - were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." - Bryona
2242286.name: 2HMace_Unique_Druid_100
2242286.power: Every 10 seconds, Pulverize forms a puddle that deals 2-4% of its damage as Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. Pulverizing the puddle splashes an additional 0.2-0.4% of the puddle's total damage within the area and around it.
stats: Core Stat Willpower Percent Higher Higher

2242301.flavor: Legends say that the Hand of Naz was not made, but cursed into being. Woe to the living who unearth it, for the price is the same regardless of form. The cavity where a gem once lay is empty.
2242301.name: Gloves_Unique_Necro_102
2242301.power: Your maximum number of Skeleton Mages is increased by 1 and they are upgraded to Arch-Mages. Arch-Mages teleport to safety when attacked and their attacks occasionally shatter on impact, dealing 80-90% increased damage to the enemy and up to 3 additional targets.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Talent Skeleton Mage

2242304.flavor: "Threefold was the sight of Oriax. He stirred the wrath of his lord Baal, and his eyes were torn and cast into the dust. Lo, the viper now crawls blind, writhing in misery." - Librarius Ex Horadrim
2242304.name: Amulet_Unique_Sorc_102
2242304.power: Hydra is now a Core Skill with increased Mana cost and its attacks now explode dealing #% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Hydra

2242307.flavor: "Know the dangers of fang and root. One hides in the leaf, the berry, the still water. The other waits in the bite, the stinger, the wound." - Teachings of Balazan, Verse III
2242307.name: Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_100
2242307.power: Your Casts damage Close enemies for 125-150% of your Thorns and also deals 100% of this damage as Poisoning over 3 seconds. Each time you've retaliated with Thorns, for 5 seconds the Poisoning damage is increased by 100%, up to 300%.

2246455.flavor: From the stump of the Blood Rose oozes a foul and black ichor—bane to flesh and blood. Blade and hide treated in the toxics are worth the fortunes of kings.
2246455.name: Gloves_Unique_Rogue_102
2246455.power: Lucky Hit: Poison or Cold Imbued Skills have up to a 35% chance to deploy a Poison Trap while it is equipped, depending on your equipped Poison Trap's element. Poison Trap gains the Infiltrator Variant for free and deals 75-90% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Poison Trap

2363567.flavor: "Tremble not before the one who has mastered a thousand incantations. Tremble before the one who has made a single spell his gospel, his body, his breath." -One Who Never Sleeps
2363567.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Necro_100
2363567.power: Your Basic Skills gain all Upgrades for free. Damaging an enemy with a Basic Skill causes them to take 30-40% increased damage from your other Basic Skills for 10 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Basic

2363572.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.
2363572.name: 1HSword_Unique_Barb_103
2363572.power: You gain 3-4% increased damage for each damaging Skill you have equipped, and an additional 6-8% for 15 seconds when each of those Skills are used.

2363606.flavor: Wreathed in bark and bone, these gauntlets carry the strength of old simian spirits - wardens of root and canopy.
2363606.name: Gloves_Unique_Spiritborn_100
2363606.power: The Protector can be invoked at range and Pulls inward with its smashes. Enemies in its area take 50-60% increased damage from your Gorilla Skills, doubled while they are Knocked Down or a Boss.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Spiritborn Category Gorilla

2363617.flavor: "The moors once belonged to the raven-changelings, child. They came with the full moon and read fate through the eyes of the dead. But that time has withered. Their songs are stilled." - Airidah
2363617.name: Pants_Unique_Druid_002
2363617.power: Ravens deal 80-100% increased damage and Shapeshifting into a different form or activating a Companion Skill Summons a Raven that attacks nearby enemies. Summoning a Raven has a chance to call forth an Unkindness for 10 seconds, increasing the number of Ravens Summoned to 3 for the duration.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Ravens

2363629.flavor: "This gem acts as a conduit for aetheric filaments, enabling the wielder to summon atmospheric discharge at will." - Excerpt from Volatus Arcanum: Of Skybinding and Stormcraft
2363629.name: Ring_Unique_Sorc_102
2363629.power: Cast Shock Skill damage leaves enemies Magnetized for 4 seconds, causing them to emit Crackling Energy and receive 40-60% increased Shock damage from you. Crackling Energy's damage Pulls Magnetized enemies together.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Category Shock

2420785.flavor: First in the Swan, the Herald by name. This is the star of morning that shines brightest, which marshals the order of all other celestial bodies.
2420785.name: 1HMace_Unique_Paladin_001
2420785.power: Blessed Hammer deals 80-100% increased damage. Lucky Hit: Up to a 20% chance to spawn a base Blessed Hammer on the target hit.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Core Blessed Hammer

2420940.flavor: Between fire and darkness, I hold the gate.
2420940.name: 1HShield_Unique_Paladin_001
2420940.power: Juggernaut Core Skills are empowered, dealing 100-120% increased damage to the first enemy hit and storing the damage dealt to that target, up to 10 times. Fortress unleashes this stored damage to all enemies within its area.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2424373.flavor: This blade favors the unguarded, the unmourned, the straggler. For it knows that all bonds weaken in time, and that even kings may be found unguarded if patience is infinite.
2424373.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Generic_001
2424373.power: Deal 90-120% increased damage to isolated enemies.

2429482.flavor: ...And when the enemy pressed too near, his bulwark became a hammer.
2429482.name: 1HShield_Unique_Paladin_002
2429482.power: Blocking has a 15% chance to retaliate with a Shield Bash. Your Shield Bash damage is increased by 80-100%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Core Shield Bash

2429563.flavor: "And the moon looked upon the pilgrims and wept a path of light. Through her tears they walked unseen, and night remembered them no more." - Orison XVII: Creed of the Dove
2429563.name: Ring_Unique_Paladin_001
2429563.power: Arbiter's Evade triggers a random equipped non-Channeled Core Skill for every 2 meters traveled. Core Skills deal 5-15% increased damage during Arbiter's Evade and for 4 seconds after.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2430686.flavor: "Of the world's first light she was borne - the White Dove, our most radiant Lady. Her visage none may behold, yet all warmed by dawn may call her friend." - Sir Morna, Order of the Dove
2430686.name: 1HShield_Unique_Paladin_003
2430686.power: Blessed Shield deals 77-99% increased damage. Casting another Skill makes your next 3 Blessed Shields double this bonus and cost 7 less Faith to Cast.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Core Blessed Shield

2439586.flavor: "...and though he marched through shadow and storm, his flame never waned. On the thirtieth day, he arrived to spread the word of Akarat's passing." - Scrolls of Yaerius
2439586.name: Boots_Unique_Paladin_001
2439586.power: Advance deals 60-80% increased damage, gains 3 Skill Ranks, and travels twice as far.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Basic Advance

2439786.flavor: The scroll's words are known to the knight alone. He supplicates to his sworn oath, lest his faith and blade find no purchase.
2439786.name: 1HSword_Unique_Paladin_001
2439786.power: Brandish unleashes in all directions dealing 120-160% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Basic Brandish

2445950.flavor: "Thus spake Que-Hegan Sankekur the righteous: when prayer fails man, let the blade be our psalm. May the blood of unbelievers be the ink which we write our faith anew." -Excerpt from Brother Ismail
2445950.name: 2HSword_Unique_Paladin_002
2445950.power: Zeal gains the Death or Glory Variant for free and deals 50-60% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Core Zeal

2446553.flavor: "Let the righteous spear judge what man cannot. Its point unmasks the heretic, its edge silences their defiance." - Judicator Moseph of the Fourth Inquisition
2446553.name: Helm_Unique_Paladin_002
2446553.power: Lucky Hit: Judicator Skills have up to a 30-40% chance to call down a Blessed Spear that carries a Judgement mark and deals Judgement's damage on impact.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Category Justice

2462030.flavor: "The path remembers the feet that tread it often. It bends its course to those who never stray." - Tarka, the Emissary
2462030.name: Boots_Unique_Spiritborn_001
2462030.power: You invoke up to 8-12 base Core Skills from your primary Spirit Hall split across every 50 meters you move. While Ravager is active, Casting Core Skills instantly dashes you to your target.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2463632.flavor: Lo, its strike is thunder, its sting a dirge. Those smote are unmade, scattered as chaff before the breath of ancients.
2463632.name: 1HMace_Unique_Sorc_100
2463632.power: For each Defensive Skill not on your Action Bar, you deal 15-25% increased damage and gain its associated Enchantment effect.

2465761.flavor: Once worn by the lost druids who sang the sandy gales to sleep. When their line was broken, the desert rose in mourning, staining the sky blood-red as Kehjistan choked beneath fifty years of dust.
2465761.name: Boots_Unique_Druid_101
2465761.power: Earthen Bulwark gains the Earthen Shrapnel Variant for free and deals 150-200% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Earthen Bulwark

2469878.flavor: "Listen, no Skeleton is gonna be my King. Leoric is King. King, so you hear me? Hail to the King!" -Farnham
2469878.name: 1HMace_Unique_Necro_100
2469878.power: Your Golem will consume one of your Skeleton Mages or Skeleton Warriors every 8 seconds, healing to full Life and gaining 100-120% increased damage for 10 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Talent Golem

2470102.flavor: "Stand tall, for on this day we bring the Light of Inarius to a land consumed by darkness!" - Urivar, before the Battle for Scosglen
2470102.name: 1HFlail_Unique_Paladin_003
2470102.power: Enemies impaled by the first strike of Divine Lance take 150-200% increased damage from Divine Lance's subsequent hits.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Core Divine Lance

2472779.flavor: "Praise Akarat, His will be done. Lead us to darkness, so our Light may shine and purify." - Zakarum prayer
2472779.name: 1HShield_Unique_Paladin_004
2472779.power: Gain 40-50% increased Strength, Resistance, Armor and Retribution Chance. Retribution gains 50% increased Size.

2473929.flavor: Sing. And so too will they sing. Rejoice. And so too will they rejoice. Fight. And so too will they fight.
2473929.name: 1HShield_Unique_Paladin_005
2473929.power: Consuming Judgement 100 times calls down Spear of the Heavens on a random enemy. Judgement on Bosses counts as 10. Your Spear of the Heavens damage is increased by 80-100%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Justice Spear Of The Heavens

2474458.flavor: "Kindle your inner flame. With it, we are the dawn that breaks the night." - Paladin Justelle
2474458.name: Gloves_Unique_Paladin_003
2474458.power: Holy Light's passive now deals # Fire Damage every second in a small area around you. Each time an enemy dies within this aura, it increases its damage by 15% and burn area by 10% for 20 seconds, up to 10 times. Activating Holy Light Aura refreshes this duration.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Aura Holy Light Aura

2475969.flavor: A token wrought from the siege of Kethamar. May the keep's defenders be anointed and borne aloft on hallow'd flame.
2475969.name: Amulet_Unique_Paladin_002
2475969.power: Arbiter form increases Aura Potency by 30% and Wing Strike damage by 86.67-100%

2476977.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.
2476977.name: 1HSword_Unique_Paladin_002
2476977.power: Dealing direct damage grants 0.8-1% increased Critical Strike Damage for each enemy hit within 10 seconds, up to 40-50%. At Maximum you gain: Lucky Hit: Critical Strikes have up to a 50% chance to deal double damage, Heal for 130-150 Life, and refresh the duration of the bonus.

2477794.flavor: This item has lost its power.
2477794.name: Boots_Unique_Paladin_95

2477797.flavor: This item has lost its power.
2477797.name: Chest_Unique_Paladin_95

2477800.flavor: This item has lost its power.
2477800.name: Glove_Unique_Paladin_95

2477804.flavor: This item has lost its power.
2477804.name: Helm_Unique_Paladin_95

2477807.flavor: This item has lost its power.
2477807.name: Pants_Unique_Paladin_95

2478180.flavor: "Heat struck my face and I thought the sun had risen early. Each swing of the hammer cleaved through the hordes, and every man shouted, wild with awe: The night ends!" - Survivor, Battle of Westmarch
2478180.name: 2HAxe_Unique_Paladin_001
2478180.power: Casting an Aura Skill triggers a Consecration beneath you. You gain 80-100% Aura Potency while standing in Consecration.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Category Aura

2478941.flavor: To chain the kin of Bul-Kathos is to gift them a weapon.
2478941.name: Pants_Unique_Barb_101
2478941.power: Casting a damaging Brawling Skill disables it afterwards. When all of these Skills that are on your Action Bar are disabled, they become re-enabled with their Cooldowns refreshed. Brawling Skills you Cast deal 80-100% increased damage for each disabled Skill.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Category Brawling

2479144.flavor: The ensign bears the words: 'Beneath Saint Lalszo the Grey's gentle gaze, the cruel laid down their wrath, and the meek rose as lions. By his grace, no lost soul shall tread alone.'
2479144.name: Chest_Unique_Paladin_001
2479144.power: Juggernaut Oath makes your Juggernaut Skills 25% larger but Consumes up to 16 Resolve, granting #% increased Juggernaut Skill damage for each point Consumed.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Paladin Category Juggernaut

2479735.flavor: "So is it written: when the Second Trumpet sounds, the wicked shall fall as stars cast down from their firmament." - Canticle of the Judgement, Verse XII
2479735.name: Ring_Unique_Paladin_002
2479735.power: Judgement deals 100-150% increased damage and has a 33% chance to explode twice when using the Judicator Oath.

2479864.flavor: No wasteland may weary the bearer of Arcadia. Beneath their path, the soil remembers its first spring, and blades of war soften into petals.
2479864.name: Pants_Unique_Paladin_002
2479864.power: Rally Fortifies you for 6-8% of your Maximum Life. Whenever you recover 8% of your Maximum Life, gain a charge of Rally.

2510762.flavor: At dawn, she sits in Judgment's stead. The host shall kneel in her radiance.
2510762.name: Amulet_Unique_Paladin_003
2510762.power: Arbiter of Justice gains all Variants and grants you 0.53-0.67% increased damage and Damage Reduction for each Skill Rank it has while in Arbiter form. This bonus doubles for 30 seconds after Arbiter of Justice lands.

2512051.flavor: "No darkness may crown the brow that bears this light. Its radiance shall endure beyond the fall of stars." - Litany of Purity, Verse VII
2512051.name: Ring_Unique_Paladin_003
