2512051.power: Lucky Hit: Holy Bolt has up to a 40% chance to trigger Purify. Purify causes enemies to take 45-55% increased damage from you for 4 seconds.

2513539.flavor: "The sun looked upon man and judged him unworthy. In wrath, the sins of the faithless were scourged in flame upon their flesh. And the day was made pure again." - Canticle of the Penitent, Verse XV
2513539.name: 1HFlail_Unique_Paladin_004
2513539.power: Heaven's Fury gains 3 additional rays and deals 85-105% increased damage.

2538578.flavor: In the first winters, a desperate spirit awoke within the hearts of men. Where famine walked, the spirit strengthened. When men consumed one another, it found its name.
2538578.name: Ring_Unique_Generic_103
2538578.power: Every 15 kills in the last 50-60 seconds increases your damage by 2%, and Attack Speed by 1%.

2538889.flavor: Each touch dulls pain. Enemies feel their vigor unravel as the poison withers their marrow and drinks deep of their strength.
2538889.name: Gloves_Unique_Generic_005
2538889.power: Attacks apply Vulnerable to Distant Enemies, and Weakened to Close Enemies. You deal 30-40% increased damage to Enemies that are both Vulnerable and Weakened.

2538899.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.
2538899.name: 1HAxe_Unique_Generic_003
2538899.power: Moving grants Ferocity, and Maximum Ferocity is increased by 2-4. Ferocity also increases Movement Speed by 6-8% per stack.

2547783.flavor: "It glows because it is pleased." -Author Unknown, blood used as inscription
2547783.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_001
2547783.power: Rampage deals 200-240% increased damage. Each enemy or demon killed by Rampage increases the size of the brute and its smashes by 5%, up to 50%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Rampage

2548620.flavor: Weave a song from the damned. Pluck their sorrows like harp strings, for there is fuel in the tears of the profane.
2548620.name: 1HSword_Unique_Warlock_001
2548620.power: Blazing Scream is now an Archfiend Skill and deals 30-50% increased damage. Blazing Scream gains the Skull Splitter Variant for free and the Lesser Demon skulls deal the same damage as the main skull.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Core Blazing Scream

2548622.flavor: Hatred begins the first cut. Terror holds the wound. Destruction comes at last, patient and certain, to devour what remains.
2548622.name: 2HSword_Unique_Warlock_001
2548622.power: Hitting enemies with a Core Skill increases the damage they take from you by 15-20% per Skill, up to 45-60%. Archfiend Demonform Skill Variants are Core Skills and cost Wrath.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2548626.flavor: "I am the voice of vengeance unsated. Brandish me and my enmity shall walk with thine. Thy grief is thy tithe. My dirge, the dread reward."
2548626.name: 2HAxe_Unique_Warlock_001
2548626.power: Your Basic Skills deal 0.4-0.5% increased damage per Wrath you have but you lose 10% Wrath per second. Every 50 Wrath gained beyond your Maximum generates 1 Dominance.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Basic

2548631.flavor: "...Tathamet's blackened, smoldering husk spiraled into the lower darkness of reality. From his putrid flesh grew the realms of the Burning Hells." -The Black Book of Lam Esen
2548631.name: 1HMace_Unique_Warlock_001
2548631.power: Hell Fracture deals 100-120% increased damage and every 3rd cast creates a triple fracture.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Core Hell Fracture

2548633.flavor: "The Primes warred, but not for glory. They did so for the joy of mayhem. How many legions of demons died simply to delight the lords of Hell?" -Tal Rasha
2548633.name: 2HMace_Unique_Warlock_001
2548633.power: You can now equip all Ultimate Skills and gain 15 Ranks in them. Hitting enemies with Non-Ultimate Skills builds up your Ultimate Skill damage by 0.85-1.25%, up to 85-125%. After starting Ultimate Skills the damage bonus is reset once all have ended.

2548635.flavor: "Adiya shrouded herself in shadow and walked amongst men. From her countless mouths poured the song of the abyss. Its sound drowned the mind in fog as she came to feed." -Annals of Hadal
2548635.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Warlock_001
2548635.power: Dread Claws deals 100-120% increased damage and additional claws fire out when you gain a stack of Shadowform.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Core Dread Claws

2548638.flavor: It grows restless in silence, thrashing against its bindings. Though the body is small, it dreams of carnage unimaginable.
2548638.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Warlock_001
2548638.power: Your Archfiend Skills deal 80-110% increased damage and casting any Archfiend Skill activates all their Lesser Demon Upgrades for free with 200% longer durations.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Category Demonology

2548640.flavor: "Whereas Andariel relishes the anticipation of pain and the fear it creates, Duriel only cares of the existence and propagation of agony." -Book of Adria
2548640.name: 1HFlail_Unique_Warlock_001
2548640.power: Umbral Chains gains the Epicenter Variant for free and deals 60-80% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Core Umbral Chains

2548918.flavor: One touch and you understand... behind their vacant gaze is a fiendish hunger, patient and unreasoning.
2548918.name: 2HStaff_Unique_AF_001

2548923.flavor: This bow has been tainted by some strange magic indeed.
2548923.name: 2HBow_Unique_AF_001
stats: April Fools Unique Bow Cluck Thrice
Tempered Generic Lucky Hit Daze Tier3

2549136.flavor: "Azmodan has plied the honeyed lures of sin. Where terror and hatred break the soul, temptation bends the faithful knee for use." -Of Primes and Lesser Evils, Volume I
2549136.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_002
2549136.power: Infernal Breath gains the Explosive Death Variant for free and deals 120-130% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Infernal Breath

2549143.flavor: "The creatures of Hell are craven, wretched things, clawing at scraps like mongrels. Hells' hundred hands do not fight. They clamber forward like cowards in the dark." -Tal Rasha
2549143.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_003
2549143.power: Tyrant's Grasp deals 100-120% increased damage and summons 5 additional demonic hands in all directions.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Tyrants Grasp

2549147.flavor: Upon the seal was graven the Name of the Ophanim. And though they were not demon, their will bent the same.
2549147.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_004
2549147.power: Profane Sentinel deals 230-270% increased damage and summons an additional eye that follows you for 10 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Profane Sentinel

2549149.flavor: "The apprentice called for one. Two answered. Then the third crawled out afterward, unfinished, screaming like it had been torn free too early." -Master Azevera
2549149.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_005
2549149.power: Sigil of Summons deals 100-140% increased damage and you can summon up to 2 additional Lesser Demons with 10 kills outside the ritual.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Sigilof Summons

2549153.flavor: "The fire of that realm is not like the fire of our world. It seems alive. Not mindless, but imbued with purpose. As if it were blood flowing through unknowable veins." -Jere Harash
2549153.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_006
2549153.power: Sigil of Chaos gains the Diabolic Rebuke Variant for free and deals 100-130% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Sigilof Chaos

2549155.flavor: "There are depths of the Hells, and even deeper still in the Abyss, where the nameless await their appointed hour. They whisper truths forbidden that erode the mind even as they enlighten it." -Elias
2549155.name: Ring_Unique_Warlock_007
2549155.power: Blazing Scream leaves Sigil of Subversion Shadow or Lava trails behind. You deal 60-80% increased Abyss or Hellfire Skill damage to enemies on Sigil of Subversion trails based on their type.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Sigilof Subversion

2549159.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." -Master Horazon
2549159.name: Amulet_Unique_Warlock_001
2549159.power: Your Demonology Skills deal 0.4-0.5% increased damage per Wrath you have and you take 0.13-0.17% reduced damage per Dominance you have.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Category Demonology

2549162.flavor: "Bind them as a sign on your hand, and the fiend shall be as frontlets between your eyes. Nail yourself to your crucibles, for pain is the road where domination is won." -The Magnus
2549162.name: Helm_Unique_Warlock_001
2549162.power: Hellion Sting deals 80-100% increased damage and bursts out of enemies when you Eviscerate them. Hellion Sting gains 0.5-2.5% Eviscerate Chance each second it has not Eviscerated.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Basic Hellion Sting

2549164.flavor: "...Our rites are written not with ink, but with blood. Not upon stone, but upon the living flesh..." -Taphya 13:6
2549164.name: Chest_Unique_Warlock_001
2549164.power: Sigil Skills deal 70-90% increased damage. Active Sigils gain 1 |4kill:kills; every second and unused kills are saved when they expire.

2549166.flavor: All of Abaddon is unshrouded before you. The denizens of Sheol tremble, for these hands are the touch of those unutterable ruins.
2549166.name: Gloves_Unique_Warlock_001
2549166.power: While Fiend of Abaddon is alive you periodically sacrifice all other Archfiend Summons, dealing Fiend of Abaddon's damage around them and increasing Fiend of Abaddon's damage by 40-50% per demon killed, up to 600-750% for 60 seconds.

2549168.flavor: In the Sunless Depths, Kabraxis wailed. No vessel could bare the Imprisoned Lord. Creation could not sustain the road he traveled, only madness remained.
2549168.name: Pants_Unique_Warlock_001
2549168.power: Wall of Agony gains the Fallen Army Variant for free and deals 20-30% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Special Wallof Agony

2549170.flavor: Step onward, and the living realm shall dim behind thee as the Black Road uncoils, eternal and cold. Even death shall fail to follow thee there.
2549170.name: Boots_Unique_Warlock_001
2549170.power: Your Evade is now Nether Step and your Evade Cooldown is reduced by 0.6-1 seconds as you lose or consume Shadowform stacks.

2549200.flavor: "As loyal as we may think they might be, they are still demons. And they will take any chance they can to destroy us." -Book of Adria
2549200.name: Boots_Unique_Warlock_002
2549200.power: Abodian deals 200-280% increased damage. Command Abodian periodically triggers your Non-Archfiend Hellfire Skills while moving and its Cooldown is reduced by 50%.

2549203.flavor: "Cut a demon nice and wide. Something rises from inside. Eye and fang, bone and sinew. What was one has become two." -Ravings of a mad Vizjerei
2549203.name: Chest_Unique_Warlock_002
2549203.power: Ae'grom and its summons deal 120-150% increased damage. You additionally summon Ae'grom's other half and gain a second Charge of Command Ae'grom.

2549205.flavor: "There are certain thresholds one must not cross. Not because the demonologist will lose their way back, but because they will not return the same as they were before." -Grimoire of Reckoning
2549205.name: Gloves_Unique_Warlock_002
2549205.power: Any Demonform grants you all Metamorphosis Upgrades for free and they are 50-100% more potent.

2549208.flavor: Faint screams emanate from the gloves, as if they are imbued with a hundred primal fears.
2549208.name: Gloves_Unique_Warlock_003
2549208.power: Terror Swarm gains the Devouring Swarm Variant for free and deals 60-100% increased damage.

2549210.flavor: "For demons whose nature is to destroy, where does it end? If everything around them is brought to ruin, I believe their final act of destruction would be themselves." -Deckard Cain
2549210.name: Gloves_Unique_Warlock_004
2549210.power: Apocalypse deals up to 290-350% increased damage when cast in Sigil of Chaos based on the number of kills the Sigil has stored. Apocalypse is now also a Sigil Skill.

2549212.flavor: "The doomed do not fall at once. They linger, falter in purpose, and then unravel. Breath shortens. Will erodes. Fortune abandons them. When death finally comes, 'tis merely overdue." -Warlord Bartuc
2549212.name: Helm_Unique_Warlock_002
2549212.power: Hex dooms enemies, maintaining the Hex and dealing 100-200% of Doom's damage every second until they die. Doom deals 140-175% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Basic Doom

2549214.flavor: "Sin begets sins as men beget men. Terror begets Hate and Hate begets Destruction. Destruction begets Terror as Terror begets Hate..." -Inscription carved inside the helm
2549214.name: Helm_Unique_Warlock_003
2549214.power: Your Evade transforms you into an angry Lunatic for up to 15 seconds that explodes dealing Command Fallen's Base damage and you gain 100-200% increased Command Fallen damage every second you are transformed. While you are an angry Lunatic, your Movement speed is increased by 60% and you periodically spawn a Mini Lunatic that seeks enemies. Command Fallen deals 100-200% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Basic Command Fallen

2549216.flavor: "We found eight corpses, arranged around a summoning circle. No wounds or blood. They were frozen in mid-scream. Whatever had appeared in the circle was gone." -Caldeum guard report
2549216.name: Helm_Unique_Warlock_004
2549216.power: Command Laalish is now an Ultimate Skill and deals 100-120% increased damage. Command Laalish's Terror Realm lasts 50% longer and while within your Abyss Skill casts do not break Shadowform Stealth.

2549218.flavor: "Destruction can be become an addiction, it is said. The first taste of it leaves you wanting more. Something within us craves ruin, yearns for annihilation." -Black Book of Lam Esen
2549218.name: Helm_Unique_Warlock_005
2549218.power: Your Brimstones and Molten Bomb deal 160-200% increased damage. Molten Bomb explodes all Brimstones instantly if there are at least 4 total but enemy proximity no longer detonates them.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Basic Molten Bomb

2549220.flavor: "Though unruly, demons are compelled to abide by certain rules. When a pact is forged, whether by force or choice, it must be upheld." -Deckard Cain
2549220.name: Pants_Unique_Warlock_002
2549220.power: Summon a Tortured Wretch when your Current Life drops below 55% of your Maximum Life. Enemies Tortured Wretch attempts to Taunt take 10-15% increased damage and deal 10-15% less damage for 20 seconds.

2549222.flavor: "What is more perfect than blood? A single drop can consecrate, empower, or curse. Know this: The most potent form is not blood stolen from others, but given from one's self." -Elias
2549222.name: Pants_Unique_Warlock_003
2549222.power: Casting Dark Prison consumes 27-48% of your Maximum Life to reset its Cooldown. You gain 25-40% Damage Reduction while Dark Prison is active.

2549224.flavor: "The morlu are incredibly resilient. Stories from the Sin War describe them fighting despite heavy wounds." -Book of Adria
2549224.name: Pants_Unique_Warlock_004
2549224.power: You cannot recover above 65% of your Maximum Life but your Defensive Skills deal 300-400% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Defensive

2549226.flavor: "Therefore, behold, the days come that it shall no more be called thine own body, nor thine own heart, but the heart of Moloch, for each heartbeat shall roar with the flames of Hell..." -Taphya 3:26
2549226.name: Amulet_Unique_Warlock_002
2549226.power: Hellfire Skills deal 13-20% increased damage for every Skill you have Empowered by Volatility. Casting a Volatility Empowered Skill increases you Core Stats by 5% for 10 seconds, up to 50%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Category Hellfire

2549228.flavor: "Sleep, my child, shut fast thine eyes, Keep thee still until sunrise. Astrogha's brood will hear thy breath, And lull thee close to dreaming death." -Westmarch lullaby
2549228.name: Amulet_Unique_Warlock_003
2549228.power: Your Abyss Skills deal 6-8% increased damage for each stack of Shadowform. This bonus is increased by 100% while you have Stealth.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Category Abyss

2549230.flavor: The warlock stared into the blood-stone until his eyes were scorched with dread knowledge. He felt an infernal current awaken in his veins—a plague of visions, malice, and command over the occult.
2549230.name: Amulet_Unique_Warlock_004
2549230.power: Bonuses from Command Valloch and the Ritualist Shard and its Fragments have 200% increased Potency. Your Occult Skills deal #% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Category Occult

2549232.flavor: "When the moon turns crimson, it is Baal's eye opening. Show him acts of destruction, and he will reward you with power." -Rites of the Triune
2549232.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Warlock_002
2549232.power: Soul Shard Skills and their demons deal 60-80% increased damage. Casting a Soul Shard Skill increases all your damage by 10% for 15 seconds, up to 50%.

2559792.flavor: "You Vizjerei believe your magic is greater than ours, so you come here seeking to become the master of this land? But I am a druid. I am the land!" -Druid Saoirse, at the defeat of Mage Lord Emre
2559792.name: Helm_Unique_Druid_100_x2
2559792.power: Earth Spike is now a launched as a projectile. Upon impact, the projectile deals # damage to the target and summons 2-4 additional Earth Spikes.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Basic Earthspike

2559813.flavor: The third lord of Hashir hungered to see all beneath his rule. A Warlock obliged and bound a demon into steel. The king bore the blade and beheld how his realm was cast down before him.
2559813.name: 1HSword_Unique_Warlock_002
2559813.power: Hitting a Lesser Demon with Bombardment explodes it for 400-600% of a Bombardment impact if the Demon has less than 3 |4second:seconds; duration left. Bombardment deals 100-120% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Warlock Core Bombardment

2559856.flavor: "Lo, Éirin has departed, she wanders with us no longer. May her peace be everlasting under the branches of Glór-an-Fháidha." -Inscription at Túr Dúlra
2559856.name: Helm_Unique_Druid_101_x2
2559856.power: Wind Shear now deals # Poisoning damage over 4 seconds. Lucky Hit: Wind Shear has up to a 20% chance to restore 100 Spirit.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Basic Wind Shear

2567888.flavor: "Strike once to expose weakness, strike again to exploit it." -Teachings of Ysevete, the First Spiritborn
2567888.name: Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_101
2567888.power: You deal 53.33-66.67% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies. After making an enemy Vulnerable, your next direct damage dealt to them: Heals you for 5% of your Maximum Life Generates 10 Vigor Removes the Vulnerable effect

2567890.flavor: "Nahantu is everchanging. Nahantu is everlasting. When the Burning Hells become ash and soot, and when the High Heavens come crashing down, Nahantu will remain." -Excerpt from Defiance of Enkasi
2567890.name: Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_102
2567890.power: The Base Spirit of a Skill cast grants: Eagle: #% Movement Speed Gorilla: #% Damage Reduction Jaguar: #% Attack Speed Centipede: #% Life per Second Casting a Skill of a different Base Spirit: Swaps to the new bonus Increases Core Stats by 100% for 7 seconds.

2567931.flavor: "One touch is all it took. She looked into my eyes, and I understood her hunger, endless and painful. I will start with the taverns and find a strong one, with strong blood." -Jios, Sarat's Servant
2567931.name: Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_103
2567931.power: Your Critical Strikes cause your Poisoning on an enemy to burst, dealing 166.67-200% of the total Poisoning instantly to them and 10% of the burst to surrounding enemies before removing the Poisoning effect from the primary target.

2570630.flavor: "They who live by fang and claw forget the feeling of human feet on soil. Of cold air on bare skin. Man and beast...thoughts, desires...merge together like blood spilled in a stream." -Nafain
2570630.name: Gloves_Unique_Druid_01_x2
2570630.power: Debilitating Roar is now a Werewolf Skill. In addition, Debilitating Roar increases your damage by 60-80% while in Werewolf form for the duration.

2570935.flavor: Ciódan was known to be a true friend of the Deep Forest. In gratitude, he was protected fiercely by nature itself.
2570935.name: Boots_Unique_Druid_01_x2
2570935.power: Poison Creeper gains the Germinate Variant for free and deals 30-40% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Vine Creeper

2571318.flavor: Fiacla-Géar's druids lived in harmony with nature. The Talons of Ifeh walked a different path. They surrendered their souls to the wilds, becoming more beast than man.
2571318.name: 1HTotem_Unique_Druid_01_x2
2571318.power: Grizzly Rage is now a Werewolf Skill and Shapeshifts you into a Dire Werewolf. Dire Werewolves gain 100-125% Critical Strike Damage, 100-125% bonus Poisoning damage and Spirit Cost Reduction instead of Armor. In addition, kills Heal you for 5% of your Maximum Life.

2571332.flavor: Each soul it severs returns as an omen of renewal, cradled in bone-white curve.
2571332.name: 2HScythe_Unique_AF_001
2571332.power: Slain enemies have a chance to lay an egg.

2571351.flavor: "You kept us from harm. Forever will you hold a place of honor. We will always look up to you...brother." -Grey of Clan Skeld
2571351.name: Chest_Unique_Druid_97_x2
2571351.power: When you hit at least 1 enemy with Maul, increase its Attack Speed by 3% and damage by 20-25% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Basic Maul

2571869.flavor: "I saw her climb to the peak of the mountains. She played a song on her talharpa, so sad it made the sky darken and rumble with thunder." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IV
2571869.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_01_x2
2571869.power: Storm Skills that you Cast grant 1 Spirit and deal 25-35% bonus damage. These bonuses are doubled when damaging a Vulnerable, Immobilized or Slowed enemy.

2571975.flavor: "Do not speak to nature. Listen to it. Learn from it. That is the only true path of knowledge." -Code of the Scéal Fada
2571975.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_02_x2
2571975.power: Casting or Channeling a Human Skill has a 15% chance to trigger an additional equipped non-Ultimate Human Skill. Human Skills deal 40-50% bonus damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Special Human

2572424.flavor: Mercy ends where the flock begins.
2572424.name: 2HPolearm_Unique_AF_001
2572424.power: Lucky Hit: Damage to Injured enemies has up to a 10-15% chance to spawn a flock of explosive chickens.

2572848.flavor: "The runestones in Scosglen are fascinating. Some act as wards, but others are conduits. They tap into the deepest power of the earth itself." -Donan
2572848.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_03_x2
2572848.power: Your Earth Skills deal 40-50% bonus Critical Strike damage. This bonus is increased to 80-100% with at least 4 stacks of Overpower. You passively gain 2 stacks of Overpower every 10 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Category Earth

2573042.flavor: You do not see your reflection on the ring's polished surface. Instead, you see other forms: creatures of fur and feather, of fang and claw.
2573042.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_04_x2
2573042.power: Your Companion Skills each gain 1 additional |4companion:companions; and deal 40-50% bonus damage. Gain the Passive Effect of Ravens, Wolves and Poison Creeper for free.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Category Companion

2573064.flavor: The Eggis was not forged, but laid by a beast most fowl.
2573064.name: 1HShield_Unique_AF_001
2573064.power: Blocking an attack has a chance to turn the attacker into a Feared chicken for 3-4 seconds.

2573106.flavor: "The tales spoke of a one-eyed wolf, a creature so cunning that it outsmarted the greatest trappers in the world. It makes you wonder if it was a wolf at all." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IX
2573106.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_05_x2
2573106.power: Gain 15-20% bonus Poisoning damage. Direct damage from Werewolf Skills gain a bonus equal to 50% of your bonus Poisoning damage, up to 50%. Poison damage from Werewolf Skills gain a bonus equal to 100% of your bonus Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance, up to 50%. Current Direct Damage bonus: #% Current Poison Damage bonus: #%

2574414.flavor: The ring pulses with primal power, but its design is delicate. Perhaps its main purpose is to remind the wearer that they are still human.
2574414.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_06_x2
2574414.power: When you Shapeshift into either Werewolf or Werebear form, you gain Berserking for 6-8 seconds. Additionally, Berserking grants 1 stack of Ferocity every 1 second while active. Berserking's damage bonus is increased by 10%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Category Shapeshifting

2574426.flavor: "To speak the tongue of a beast is more than just trading words. It changes how you see the world. It changes how you know fear, strength, and tenacity." -Greenwalker Ciórdan
2574426.name: Ring_Unique_Druid_07_x2
2574426.power: Gain 7-9% bonus Werebear damage for each stack of Resolve while in Werebear form. Additionally, you automatically gain 1 stack of Resolve every 1 seconds while in Werebear form.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Category Werebear

2574434.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left—stone, silver, and sanctified relics—were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." -Bryona
2574434.name: 2HMace_Unique_Druid_100_x2
2574434.power: Pulverize pulls Distant enemies towards you. In addition, Pulverize deals 50-62.5% bonus damage. This damage bonus is increased to 100-125% if the target was pulled towards you, is Unstoppable or a Boss.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Druid Core Pulverize

2580668.flavor: "Tell us, Oracle Queen, of our great Amazon Sister, who wandered far from her home into the Heart of Terror." -Ode to the Warmatron
2580668.name: 2HBow_Unique_Rogue_002_x2
2580668.power: Your Arrow Storms last 2 seconds shorter, deal 60-90% increased damage, and, when created, have a 50% chance to create an additional Arrow Storm on a nearby target.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Arrow Storm

2580715.flavor: "She wished only to protect her sister. She journeyed far to Ivgorod. After years of training she returned home, being the only outsider to ever master the six techniques." -Legends of the Iron Rose
2580715.name: Gloves_Unique_Rogue_001_x2
2580715.power: Damaging a Close enemy with Marksman or Cutthroat Skills each grant a 15% Attack Speed bonus for 8 seconds. While both Attack Speed bonuses are active, you deal 45-60% increased damage to Close enemies.

2580846.flavor: Pirates rarely gather under a single Captain, but when they do, they raid from Skovos to Xiansai. The last was known as the Scourge of the Twin Seas, and left a crimson wake for decades.
2580846.name: Gloves_Unique_Rogue_002_x2
2580846.power: Casting or Channeling a Cutthroat Skill grants a stack of Momentum, up to 10. Casting a Marksman Skill removes a stack of Momentum. For each stack of Momentum, you gain: 2.5-3% Maximum Energy 2.5-3% Energy Regeneration 5-6% Increased Damage

2580865.flavor: "Prepare thoroughly before approaching any warlock. Fill your elixirs, replenish your arrows. Oil and sheath your blades before you depart." -Arts of the Viz-Jaq'taar
2580865.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_003_x2
2580865.power: Dealing 2 different types of Non-Physical damage increases the Potency of your Imbuement Skills by 45-60% and Non-Physical damage by 45-60% for 8 seconds. Basic Skills are now Imbueable.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Category Imbuements

2580898.flavor: A trapped prey only awaits a swift death. Sisters of the Sightless Eye will grant them this mercy.
2580898.name: 1HSword_Unique_Rogue_001_x2
2580898.power: Lucky Hit: Dealing damage to an enemy affected by a Trap Skill has up to a 40% chance to: Reduce the active Cooldowns of your Trap Skills by 30% Increase your Trap Skill damage by 9-12% for 10 seconds, up to 45-60%

2581723.flavor: "My feet do not ache—there is no greater pain than stopping. Into the Abyss I go. I will find her. I will bring her home. Hell cannot keep me from her, but it is welcome to try." - Unknown
2581723.name: Boots_Unique_Rogue_001_x2
2581723.power: Evading leaves behind Caltrops. Caltrops gain 50% increased Size and deal 75-90% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Special Caltrops

2581798.flavor: An old mark of office from the town of Staalbreak, in the Dreadlands. The rage of its last owner still emanates from within.
2581798.name: Amulet_Unique_Barb_102_x2
2581798.power: Berserking's damage bonus is increased by 56.66-73.33%. While not Healthy, you are always Berserk.

2581809.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker
2581809.name: Amulet_Unique_Barb_103_x2
2581809.power: Casting a Skill with a Two-Handed Bludgeoning, Two-Handed Slashing, or Dual-Wielded weapon grants 15-20% increased damage for 15 seconds. While all three bonuses are active, you gain 25% Crowd Control Duration and Attack Speed.

2581812.flavor: "O Crane, what news do you bring from our mountain? Long have I been away, in strange lands. I yearn for home, for the highland snows, Why silent, Crane? Have you no news from Arreat?"
2581812.name: Amulet_Unique_Barb_104_x2
2581812.power: Core Skills deal 30-40% increased damage, but cost 25% more Fury. The damage is doubled against Injured and Healthy enemies.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Generic Category Core

2581814.flavor: Ever watchful were the Patriarchs, as the Unclean slowly made their way out of the Dreadlands.
2581814.name: Amulet_Unique_Barb_105_x2
2581814.power: When inflicting Damage Over Time, you have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to increase the damage amount by 75-90%.

2582107.flavor: "Deep in the Labyrinth, I found true darkness. The Hidden became my shadow, their attacks sudden and relentless. But I studied them, and found I too can enter the ether." -Moreina's Journals
2582107.name: Pants_Unique_Rogue_001_x2
2582107.power: Whenever you gain Stealth, you also gain Concealment. Gain 25-30% increased Damage Reduction while Stealthed and for 8 seconds after breaking it.

2582515.flavor: "I am a symphony of blades at your disposal. No need to get your hands dirty, I will deal with any blood or body work. So, how much gold do you have?" -Mouse, Assassin for Hire
2582515.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_004_x2
2582515.power: Twisting Blades impales an extra set of blades into its target, dealing 45-60% increased damage and creating additional blades that return to you.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Rogue Core Twisting Blades

2583609.flavor: "Though he was stuck with a dozen arrows, the barbarian charged Rakkis' lines and swept away any who stood before him. The more he bled, the more ferocious were his blows." -The Chronicles of Rakkis
2583609.name: Chest_Unique_Barb_102_x2
2583609.power: Hammer of the Ancients deals 22.5-30% increased damage on consecutive hits to the same target. This stacks up to 3 times.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Barb Core Hammerofthe Ancients

2583613.flavor: "Even as a boy, Qual-Kehk's strength was the stuff of legend. It was said he could split oak trees in two with one throw of his blade." -Feats of Arreat, Vol. IV
2583613.name: Gloves_Unique_Barb_102_x2
2583613.power: Mighty Throw now gains multiplicative damage instead of cooldown from Cooldown Reduction at 75-100% effectiveness.

2583871.flavor: "I saw her climb to the peak of the mountains. She played a song on her talharpa, so sad it made the sky darken and rumble with thunder." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IV
2583871.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_01_x2
2583871.power: Storm Skills that you Cast grant 1 Spirit and deal 25-35% bonus damage. These bonuses are doubled when damaging a Vulnerable, Immobilized or Slowed enemy.

2583959.flavor: "Do not speak to nature. Listen to it. Learn from it. That is the only true path of knowledge." -Code of the Scéal Fada
2583959.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_02_x2
2583959.power: Casting or Channeling a Human Skill has a 15% chance to trigger an additional equipped non-Ultimate Human Skill. Human Skills deal 40-50% bonus damage.

2583963.flavor: "The runestones in Scosglen are fascinating. Some act as wards, but others are conduits. They tap into the deepest power of the earth itself." -Donan
2583963.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_03_x2
2583963.power: Your Earth Skills deal 40-50% bonus Critical Strike damage. This bonus is increased to 80-100% with at least 4 stacks of Overpower. You passively gain 2 stacks of Overpower every 10 seconds.

2583966.flavor: You do not see your reflection on the ring's polished surface. Instead, you see other forms: creatures of fur and feather, of fang and claw.
2583966.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_04_x2
2583966.power: Your Companion Skills each gain 1 additional |4companion:companions; and deal 40-50% bonus damage. Gain the Passive Effect of Ravens, Wolves and Poison Creeper for free.

2583968.flavor: "The tales spoke of a one-eyed wolf, a creature so cunning that it outsmarted the greatest trappers in the world. It makes you wonder if it was a wolf at all." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IX
2583968.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_05_x2
2583968.power: Gain 15-20% bonus Poisoning damage. Direct damage from Werewolf Skills gain a bonus equal to 50% of your bonus Poisoning damage, up to 50%. Poison damage from Werewolf Skills gain a bonus equal to 100% of your bonus Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance, up to 50%. Current Direct Damage bonus: #% Current Poison Damage bonus: #%

2583970.flavor: The ring pulses with primal power, but its design is delicate. Perhaps its main purpose is to remind the wearer that they are still human.
2583970.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_06_x2
2583970.power: When you Shapeshift into either Werewolf or Werebear form, you gain Berserking for 6-8 seconds. Additionally, Berserking grants 1 stack of Ferocity every 1 second while active. Berserking's damage bonus is increased by 10%.

2583972.flavor: "To speak the tongue of a beast is more than just trading words. It changes how you see the world. It changes how you know fear, strength, and tenacity." -Greenwalker Ciórdan
2583972.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_07_x2
2583972.power: Gain 7-9% bonus Werebear damage for each stack of Resolve while in Werebear form. Additionally, you automatically gain 1 stack of Resolve every 1 seconds while in Werebear form.

2583981.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.
2583981.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001
2583981.power: Your attacks Critically Strike Injured Enemies. Killing Elites Fears and Slows nearby enemies by 85-95% for 2 seconds.

2583983.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.
2583983.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HAxe_Unique_Generic_003
2583983.power: Moving grants Ferocity, and Maximum Ferocity is increased by 2-4. Ferocity also increases Movement Speed by 6-8% per stack.

2583985.flavor: This blade favors the unguarded, the unmourned, the straggler. For it knows that all bonds weaken in time, and that even kings may be found unguarded if patience is infinite.
2583985.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Generic_001
2583985.power: Deal 90-120% increased damage to isolated enemies.

2583987.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.
2583987.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Generic_100
2583987.power: After Freeze expires, enemies take 120-150% of the damage you dealt to them while Frozen.

2583990.flavor: "His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved." - Scholar's Notes
2583990.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Generic_101
2583990.power: After you spend 275 of your Primary Resource, gain 4 stacks of Overpower. Consuming Overpower increases your Critical Strikes damage by 86.67-100% for 8 seconds.

2583992.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights
2583992.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Generic_102
2583992.power: You are always Berserking but take 200% increased damage as Burning over 8 seconds. While Burning, Berserking grants an additional 80-100% increased damage.

2583994.flavor: Remorseful devotees of the Cathedral of Light must undertake a grueling pilgrimage, journeying across the frigid glacier known as the Serac Rapture. Only then may their gravest sins be forgiven.
2583994.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Generic_001
2583994.power: You are permanently Unhindered and leave behind a trail of frost that Chills enemies. Your Chill effects cause enemies to take 10-15% increased damage from you.

2583997.flavor: "Considered a failure by their creator, it wasn't until the assassination of an "untouchable" Caldeum noble that these boots' true power was understood." - Barrett's Book of Implements
2583997.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Generic_002
2583997.power: Each enemy you Evade through reduces your active Ultimate Cooldown by 3-4 seconds, up to 10 seconds.

2584000.flavor: These greaves are imbued with the divine blessing of Yen, the Veradani goddess of restoration. They bestow the wearer a revitalizing strength that enhances their own.
2584000.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Generic_003
2584000.power: Casting a Skill has a 40-60% chance to trigger a Non-Mobility, Non-Ultimate Skill that is currently on Cooldown. Can only occur once every 8 seconds.

2584003.flavor: Crafted by the cannibal Armoda, each piece of this interlocking armor has been sharpened into a knife's edge. Even a century after death, the plate remained on her corpse, unable to be removed safely.
2584003.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Generic_100
2584003.power: Thorns has a 30% chance to deal 200-250% increased damage.

2584005.flavor: "To create such an artifact would require an impossible mastery over alchemy, transmutation and the subtle magics of the soul. By all rights, it should not exist, yet it does." - Artisan Callas
2584005.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Generic_101
2584005.power: Your Healing Potions grant a Barrier for 100% of your Maximum Life for 1 second. You gain 25-30% Damage Reduction while you have a Barrier and may drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.

2584007.flavor: "Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life." - Zurke
2584007.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Generic_002
2584007.power: Your attacks randomly deal 1% to 250-300% of their normal damage.

2584009.flavor: A touch so frigid it stops the heart and chills the very soul.
2584009.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Generic_003
2584009.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a 50% chance to Freeze enemies for 1 second. You deal 40-50% increased damage to Frozen enemies.

2584011.flavor: Crafted from fragments of Duriel's carapace, wearing these gloves, or being struck by them, causes an agonizing sensation akin to pushing one's hands through a thousand shards of glass.
2584011.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Generic_004
2584011.power: Damaging enemies with a Non-Basic Skill cast marks them for 3 seconds. When a Basic Skill first hits a marked enemy, the Basic Skill's damage is echoed to all marked enemies, dealing 100-125% increased damage.

2584013.flavor: Each touch dulls pain. Enemies feel their vigor unravel as the poison withers their marrow and drinks deep of their strength.
2584013.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Generic_005
2584013.power: Attacks apply Vulnerable to Distant Enemies, and Weakened to Close Enemies. You deal 30-40% increased damage to Enemies that are both Vulnerable and Weakened.

2584015.flavor: "The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all." - Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast
2584015.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generic_003
2584015.power: When you attempt to Incapacitate an enemy, you mark them and all surrounding enemies, pulling them in and dealing 7.5-10% increased damage to them.

2584017.flavor: "The revelation that master tailor Callas was in fact a witch only served to further fuel the desire for her uniquely enchanted legwraps." - Barrett's Book of Implements
2584017.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Generic_100
2584017.power: Effects that Heal you beyond 100% Life grant you Barrier equal to 80-100% of the overhealed amount that lasts for 8 seconds. You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.

2584021.flavor: “May the Light of Father Inarius shine down upon all weary travelers of this holy land. Turn your face toward his radiance and find your strength renewed.” - Statue Inscription
2584021.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Generic_101
2584021.power: When you take damage from a Non-Physical damage type, you gain 130-160% Resistance to that damage type for 6 seconds. This effect can only apply to one damage type at a time.

2584023.flavor: "The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing." - Crusader Pembroke
2584023.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Generic_102
2584023.power: You deal 15-20% increased damage and gain 25 Primary Resource Regeneration while Unstoppable and for 5 seconds after.

2584025.flavor: "Every tome, every scroll, every book in this temple produces the same answer. The only being willing to stand against the Eternal Conflict, against the Prime Evils, was Lilith." - Elias
2584025.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generic_100
2584025.power: If a Core Skill hits 4 or more enemies, 50-60% of the Resource cost is refunded.

2584027.flavor: Skulking in the shadows of the Realm of Destruction, the Scarred Baron plots the downfall of the mortal who banished him there.
2584027.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generic_102
2584027.power: Each Damage over Time type you apply explodes every second, dealing # damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies.

2584030.flavor: In the first winters, a desperate spirit awoke within the hearts of men. Where famine walked, the spirit strengthened. When men consumed one another, it found its name.
2584030.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generic_103
2584030.power: Every 15 kills in the last 50-60 seconds increases your damage by 2%, and Attack Speed by 1%.

2584032.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.
2584032.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001
2584032.power: Basic Skills deal 70-100% increased damage but additionally cost 25 Primary Resource.

2584034.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.
2584034.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Amulet_Unique_Generic_001
2584034.power: Critical Strikes deal 80-100% increased damage but your Critical Strike Chance is reduced by 50%.

2584036.flavor: Tread carefully on the plains of Hell, for each step sunders the soul and shatters the mind.
2584036.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Boots_Unique_Generic_001
2584036.power: When you cast a Skill with a Cooldown, you explode, dealing # Fire damage.

2584038.flavor: Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.
2584038.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Gloves_Unique_Generic_001
2584038.power: When you would be damaged for at least 30% of your Maximum Life at once, it is instead distributed over the next 4 seconds and reduced by 15-20%.

2584040.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.
2584040.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Helm_Unique_Generic_001
2584040.power: Each time you use a Skill with a Primary Resource Cost, gain 5-7.5% increased damage and Resource Cost is increased by 30% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times.

2584799.flavor: The venom from these fangs was known to cause severe blisters and burns - forever. The Zann Esu were known to use them to fashion blades, supplementing their own abilities.
2584799.name: 1HDagger_Unique_Sorc_100_x2
2584799.power: Inferno constricts the area 2 more times and deals 20-25% increased damage.

2584868.flavor: Mage halls across Sanctuary boast of their prodigious alumni, trained from an early age. However, one might argue that these talented children would have become powerful Wizards in their own right.
2584868.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_102_x2
2584868.power: Deep Freeze gains the Glacier Variant for free and its final blast deals 400-500% increased damage.

2584899.flavor: The Unclean burned the Monastery, and all knowledge within. They beheaded the monks, and kept their tongues. All artifacts were lost - save for this.
2584899.name: Ring_Unique_Generic_104_x2
2584899.power: Lightning damage against Close enemies has a 25% chance to grant Resolve and deal 250-300% increased damage.

2584911.flavor: "From the Judgement of Inarius, the Firstborn faced suffering of all kinds. As the land of Atanos sank, the land of Skartara erupted..." -Tome recovered from Kasama
2584911.name: Helm_Unique_Sorc_102_x2
2584911.power: Firewall has 80-100% increased damage and it's size is overcapped by 100%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Firewall

2585929.flavor: "To walk the Path of Zerae, do not seek to control the storm within. Lose yourself to it, let it leave your body and become your shroud. Then you will see yourself as its master." -Queen Xaera
2585929.name: 2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_101_x2
2585929.power: Unstable Currents increases your Armor and Resistances by 100% and kills increase your damage by #% for the duration.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Category Shock

2586002.flavor: Many adventurers have sailed the Frozen Sea, but most are lost to the depths. Legend has it the first to return spoke of a vast treasure. Alas, he could not carry it alone. Save for one relic.
2586002.name: 1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_103_x2
2586002.power: Frozen Orb now returns to you dealing 100-120% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Core 6 Frozen Orb

2586233.flavor: Pillaged from the charred remains of Lord Bareen. It still feels hot to the touch.
2586233.name: Ring_Unique_Sorc_103_x2
2586233.power: Your Pyromancy Critical Strike Damage is increased by 60-80% against Healthy enemies and your Pyromancy Critical Strike Chance is increased by 40-60% against Injured enemies. Killing an enemy with a Critical Strike grants both bonuses against all enemies as well as 50% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

2586358.flavor: Ksathra's strike roiled the seas, swallowing the land. The sky raged, unleashing devastating storms. In a moment, their empire gone. Their bond forever broken. Her sister, no more.
2586358.name: Ring_Unique_Generic_105_x2
2586358.power: Your Freeze effects cause enemies to permanently take 10-15% increased Cold damage from you for each second they are Frozen.

2586393.flavor: The greatest power is often the shortest lived.
2586393.name: Amulet_Unique_Sorc_103_x2
2586393.power: Overpower increases your Pyromancy Skill damage by 13.33-16.67% and size, Mana cost and Cooldowns by 10%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Category Pyromancy

2586422.flavor: Made from the finger of a silver-haired mage
2586422.name: Ring_Unique_Sorc_104_x2
2586422.power: Casting Pyromancy Skills Burns you for 5% of your Maximum Life over 10 seconds. You inflict 200-250% increased Burning damage based on how much of your Life is Burning.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Category Pyromancy

2587261.flavor: "We passed through the Fields of Judgement. The cold there...it chills your bones, and freezes your soul. Only I made it to the summit. The rest sit in prayer for eternity." - The Pilgrimage of Agoa
2587261.name: Gloves_Unique_Sorc_103_x2
2587261.power: Frost Bolt pierces through Crowd Controlled and Unstoppable enemies and deals 80-100% increased damage.

2587293.flavor: The bandit lay on the floor, as a bolt of lightning arced between his friends. He watched the Sorceress walk away calmly as his friends fell to the floor, one by one.
2587293.name: Gloves_Unique_Sorc_102_x2
2587293.power: Spark shocks enemies 1-9 additional times and deals 20-30% increased damage.

2587676.flavor: "The executioner's hands are imprinted with the essence of every life they have taken. They do not understand this, though. But we who seek Balance do." -Books of Kalan
2587676.name: Gloves_Unique_Necro_103
2587676.power: Sever deals 35-50% increased damage and sends out 1 additional specter to attack a nearby enemy.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Core Sever

2587855.flavor: The Firstborn sorrow is not forgotten, but sleeps in the sea, and in time wakes again.
2587855.name: Chest_Unique_Sorc_100_x2
2587855.power: Blizzard's effects linger on enemies for an additional 100-120% of its duration.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Sorc Special Blizzard

2587890.flavor: "There is something akin to desire that I have sensed in the dead. A longing to serve, to be of purpose in their new state of being. Do not deny them that purpose." -Books of Kalan
2587890.name: Gloves_Unique_Necro_104
2587890.power: Your maximum number of Skeleton Warriors is increased by 1. Skeleton Warriors cleave with their attacks and deal 40-50% increased damage. Commanding them onto a target increases the damage that target takes from your Skeleton Warriors by 40-50%.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Talent Skeleton Warrior

2587965.flavor: "There is no true death. There is only the movement from one world to another. I stand in both of these worlds." -Necromancer Zayl
2587965.name: Helm_Unique_Necro_101
2587965.power: Your maximum number of Skeleton Warriors and Skeleton Mages is increased by 4 and your Summon damage is increased by 15-25%. Commanding Skeleton Warriors also causes Skeleton Mages to focus the same target for 5 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Category Minion

2587992.flavor: "Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain
2587992.name: Ring_Unique_Necro_100_x2
2587992.power: Your Minions gain 30-35% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance. When one of your Minions die, your other Minions enrage, dealing 30-35% increased damage for 3 seconds.

2588103.flavor: Legend says those who survive the Hall of Mirrors emerge forever changed, able to enchant objects with an innate cold.
2588103.name: Boots_Unique_Sorc_101_x2
2588103.power: Ice Armor gains the Permafrost Variant for free and has 20-25% increased potency.

2588765.flavor: "There have been tales, though I cannot attest to their veracity, of Necromancers drawing power from their anger, from their belief that the world has shifted far out of Balance." -Deckard Cain
2588765.name: Chest_Unique_Necro_101_x2
2588765.power: Bone Spirit explodes an additional time, dealing 35-45% of normal damage. Bone Spirit deals 30-40% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Special Bone Spirit

2588951.flavor: The ensign bears the words: 'Beneath Saint Lalszo the Grey's gentle gaze, the cruel laid down their wrath, and the meek rose as lions. By his grace, no lost soul shall tread alone.'
2588951.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Paladin_001
2588951.power: Juggernaut Oath makes your Juggernaut Skills 25% larger but Consumes up to 16 Resolve, granting #% increased Juggernaut Skill damage for each point Consumed.

2589144.flavor: "Praise Akarat, His will be done. Lead us to darkness, so our Light may shine and purify." - Zakarum prayer
2589144.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Paladin_004
2589144.power: Gain 40-50% increased Strength, Resistance, Armor and Retribution Chance. Retribution gains 50% increased Size.

2589167.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.
2589167.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Paladin_002
2589167.power: Dealing direct damage grants 0.8-1% increased Critical Strike Damage for each enemy hit within 10 seconds, up to 40-50%. At Maximum you gain: Lucky Hit: Critical Strikes have up to a 50% chance to deal double damage, Heal for 130-150 Life, and refresh the duration of the bonus.

2589198.flavor: "And the moon looked upon the pilgrims and wept a path of light. Through her tears they walked unseen, and night remembered them no more." - Orison XVII: Creed of the Dove
2589198.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Paladin_001
2589198.power: Arbiter's Evade triggers a random equipped non-Channeled Core Skill for every 2 meters traveled. Core Skills deal 5-15% increased damage during Arbiter's Evade and for 4 seconds after.

2589213.flavor: "So is it written: when the Second Trumpet sounds, the wicked shall fall as stars cast down from their firmament." - Canticle of the Judgement, Verse XII
2589213.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Paladin_002
2589213.power: Judgement deals 100-150% increased damage and has a 33% chance to explode twice when using the Judicator Oath.

2589221.flavor: "Let the righteous spear judge what man cannot. Its point unmasks the heretic, its edge silences their defiance." - Judicator Moseph of the Fourth Inquisition
2589221.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Paladin_002
2589221.power: Lucky Hit: Judicator Skills have up to a 30-40% chance to call down a Blessed Spear that carries a Judgement mark and deals Judgement's damage on impact.

2589239.flavor: A token wrought from the siege of Kethamar. May the keep's defenders be anointed and borne aloft on hallow'd flame.
2589239.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Paladin_002
2589239.power: Arbiter form increases Aura Potency by 30% and Wing Strike damage by 86.67-100%

2589247.flavor: "Heat struck my face and I thought the sun had risen early. Each swing of the hammer cleaved through the hordes, and every man shouted, wild with awe: The night ends!" - Survivor, Battle of Westmarch
2589247.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HAxe_Unique_Paladin_001
2589247.power: Casting an Aura Skill triggers a Consecration beneath you. You gain 80-100% Aura Potency while standing in Consecration.

2589255.flavor: Sing. And so too will they sing. Rejoice. And so too will they rejoice. Fight. And so too will they fight.
2589255.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Paladin_005
2589255.power: Consuming Judgement 100 times calls down Spear of the Heavens on a random enemy. Judgement on Bosses counts as 10. Your Spear of the Heavens damage is increased by 80-100%.

2589261.flavor: No wasteland may weary the bearer of Arcadia. Beneath their path, the soil remembers its first spring, and blades of war soften into petals.
2589261.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Paladin_002
2589261.power: Rally Fortifies you for 6-8% of your Maximum Life. Whenever you recover 8% of your Maximum Life, gain a charge of Rally.

2589327.flavor: "These Priests of Rathma are quite peculiar. Is it possible to dabble in the forbidden yet uphold Balance? Too often, the power of such magic leads to corruption." –The Writings of Abd al-Hazir
2589327.name: Boots_Unique_Necro_102
2589327.power: Blood Mist casts Corpse Explosion on surrounding Corpses. When Blood Mist detonates a Corpse, its Cooldown is reduced by 1 second and you gain 50-60% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Special Blood Mist

2589351.flavor: "The spark of life flows through blood, just as the spark of unlife flows through desiccated bone. There is power in both, if one knows how to use it." -Necromancer Zayl
2589351.name: Amulet_Unique_Necro_100_x2
2589351.power: Gain 2 Maximum Overpower. Blood Orbs grant 2 stacks of Overpower. Your Blood Skills consume 1 stack of Overpower to deal 86.67-100% increased damage.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Category Blood

2589377.flavor: "Necromancers uphold the Balance between Light and Dark, life and death. Yet it is only natural, only human, that an individual might tend toward one or the other." -Deckard Cain
2589377.name: 1HShield_Unique_Necro_101
2589377.power: Shadow damage infects enemies with Shadowblight for 2 seconds. Every 6th time an enemy receives Shadow damage from you while they are affected by Shadowblight, they take an additional 500-600% of that damage as Corrupting damage over 4 seconds.
stats: Skill Rank Bonus Necro Category Darkness

2589387.flavor: "Prey not on innocents, but instill fear in those who would." -Books of Kalan
2589387.name: Amulet_Unique_Necro_102
2589387.power: Vulnerable, Weakened, Crowd Controlled, or Corrupted enemies are Afflicted, taking 60% increased damage from you. Curse Skills deal # Shadow damage when applied to Afflicted enemies.

2589678.flavor: The Philios Games were said to welcome the prideful, the reckless, and the condemned.
2589678.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogue_98
2589678.power: The first direct damage you deal to an enemy is a guaranteed Critical Strike. When a Marksman Skill first Critically Strikes, it gains 90-120% increased damage, and you gain 1 Overpower. This can stack up to 4 over your Maximum Overpower.

2589680.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_101
2589680.power: Gain 1 Ferocity every 2 seconds as long as no enemies are Close to you. Your Marksman Skills deal 12-15% increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

2589682.flavor: "She wished only to protect her sister. She journeyed far to Ivgorod. After years of training she returned home, being the only outsider to ever master the six techniques." -Legends of the Iron Rose
2589682.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogue_001_x2
2589682.power: Damaging a Close enemy with Marksman or Cutthroat Skills each grant a 15% Attack Speed bonus for 8 seconds. While both Attack Speed bonuses are active, you deal 45-60% increased damage to Close enemies.

2589684.flavor: Pirates rarely gather under a single Captain, but when they do, they raid from Skovos to Xiansai. The last was known as the Scourge of the Twin Seas, and left a crimson wake for decades.
2589684.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogue_002_x2
2589684.power: Casting or Channeling a Cutthroat Skill grants a stack of Momentum, up to 10. Casting a Marksman Skill removes a stack of Momentum. For each stack of Momentum, you gain: 2.5-3% Maximum Energy 2.5-3% Energy Regeneration 5-6% Increased Damage

2589686.flavor: "I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers." - Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot
2589686.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001
2589686.power: Your Core Skills deal 45-60% increased damage for 5 seconds when Consuming 3 Combo Points. Casting Basic Skills always generates 3 Combo Points. Generating Combo Points allows you to generate the same amount of Combo Points for 1.5 |4second:seconds; when you spend them.

2589688.flavor: "He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been." - Excerpt from a burned parchment
2589688.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Rogue_001
2589688.power: Lucky Hit: Imbued Skills have up to a 40% chance to trigger a large explosion, dealing 75% of the damage dealt and applying the Imbuement effect to each enemy it hits with 120-150% Potency.

2589690.flavor: The Viz-Jaq'taar descended on the mages indiscriminately and silently as a plague. The wise took flight, whilst the foolish fortified their dwellings as if walls or wards protected from shadow.
2589690.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Rogue_101
2589690.power: Mobility Skills are always Shadow Imbued with 45-60% increased potency. Lucky Hit: Damaging an Elite or Boss with a Mobility Skill has up to a 45-60% chance to instantly trigger a free Shadow Imbuement explosion.

2589692.flavor: "Prepare thoroughly before approaching any Warlock. Fill your elixirs, replenish your arrows. Oil and sheath your blades before you depart." -Arts of the Viz-Jaq'taar
2589692.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_003_x2
2589692.power: Dealing 2 different types of Non-Physical damage increases the Potency of your Imbuement Skills by 45-60% and Non-Physical damage by 45-60% for 8 seconds. Basic Skills are now Imbueable.

2589694.flavor: "Rumor has it he lost them in a game of Skull & Anchor, but the boss is a devil with the dice. I think he wanted to give the poor sod something to keep him warm without wounding his pride." - Elstir
2589694.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Rogue_100
2589694.power: Your Trap Skills can be thrown and deal 45-60% increased damage.

2589696.flavor: "The element of surprise is the starting point. In this moment, be sure to finish it." - Kashya
2589696.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_102
2589696.power: Your Grenades gain 50% increased Size and deal 75-90% increased damage. Enemies damaged by Grenade Skills become either Vulnerable or Weakened for 4 seconds.

2589698.flavor: A trapped prey awaits only a swift death. Sisters of the Sightless Eye will grant them this mercy.
2589698.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Rogue_001_x2
2589698.power: Lucky Hit: Dealing damage to an enemy affected by a Trap Skill has up to a 40% chance to: Reduce the active Cooldowns of your Trap Skills by 30% Increase your Trap Skill damage by 9-12% for 10 seconds, up to 45-60%

2589700.flavor: "Genai grew proud and fond of boasting of her hunting prowess. She claimed she was fast enough to catch even the spirit Leraye, who cursed her for such an insult." - Fable of Genai's Twenty Trials
2589700.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Rogue_100
2589700.power: When you Cast a non-Channeled Ultimate Skill, it Consumes all of your Energy and deals 0.6-0.75% increased damage per Energy Consumed. Using a Cooldown restores 25 Energy.

2589702.flavor: The ring shifts and spins on your finger as the forces within desperately attempt to escape.
2589702.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_100
2589702.power: Your Subterfuge Skills create a Decoy Trap that Taunts and lures enemies, dealing # Corrupting damage over 6 seconds. This counts as a Trap Skill and only one Decoy can be active at a time.

2589704.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.
2589704.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001
2589704.power: Your Subterfuge Skills create an attackable Shade Totem for 6-8 seconds. Any damage it takes is replicated onto surrounding enemies at 50% effectiveness. This effect is treated as a Trap Skill. You may only have 1 |4Shade Totem:Shade Totems; active at a time.

2591837.flavor: Long ago, the Sunbird swallowed the sun whole. In the dark, the Spiritborn Xipil crawled to its nest and tore the sun free from the bird's gullet. Since, its throat was scorched red for its folly.
2591837.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_100
2591837.power: Picking up a Storm Feather forms a firestorm around you for 12 seconds dealing # Fire damage every 0.5 seconds. Every 5 additional Storm Feathers you pick up intensifies the firestorm, increasing its damage by 100% but not refreshing its duration. Storm Feathers are now Jaguar Skills and the firestorm is an Eagle, Jaguar, and Storm Feather Skill.

2591853.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.
2591853.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Spiritborn_013_x1
2591853.power: Spending Vigor Heals you for 7-10% of your Maximum Life. Every second, your active Cooldowns each drain 10% Maximum Life from you to reduce their durations by 2 seconds.

2591861.flavor: "Fear not the limits of your flesh, Spiritborn! As our ancestors said: wushe nak pa! Transcend your being!" - Maka
2591861.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_010_x1
2591861.power: Casting an Ultimate Skill grants or amplifies its matching Primary Spirit Hall Bonus with #% potency for 15 seconds. Your Ultimate Skills each gain an additional Skill Type: The Seeker is a Focus Skill. The Hunter is a Mobility Skill. The Devourer is a Potency Skill. The Protector is a Defensive Skill.

2591865.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.
2591865.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_009_x1
2591865.power: According to your secondary Spirit Hall choice, your Skills are all additionally Jaguar, Eagle, Gorilla, or Centipede Skills. Your Skills deal 25-30% increased damage per Spirit type they have.

2591872.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.
2591872.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_011_x1
2591872.power: While your Spirit Hall choices match: Their bonuses are 100% more potent. Skills of their Base Spirit gain 50-60% Vigor Cost Reduction. Skills of their Base Spirit gain 50-60% Cooldown Reduction.

2591877.flavor: "To commune with spirits, listen to whispers unseen. Root yourself unto the earth and let its pulse still the mind. Hear the ancient guardians – they rise to aid you." -Ysevete, the First Spiritborn
2591877.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_015_x1
2591877.power: While moving, you gain 25-30% Dodge Chance and Damage Reduction. After standing still for 2 seconds, you become Unstoppable until you move.

2591879.flavor: "Know the dangers of fang and root. One hides in the leaf, the berry, the still water. The other waits in the bite, the stinger, the wound." - Teachings of Balazan, Verse III
2591879.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_100
2591879.power: Your Casts damage Close enemies for 125-150% of your Thorns and also deals 100% of this damage as Poisoning over 3 seconds. Each time you've retaliated with Thorns, for 5 seconds the Poisoning damage is increased by 100%, up to 300%.

2591882.flavor: "A relic of an old, forgotten religion lost to time and expansion. The staff retains a faint warmth as if still blessed by the dead god it once served." - Ser Paget's notes from the Tiklan excavation
2591882.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_001
2591882.power: Your Focus Skills benefit from all their Upgrades, and they increase the damage of your Potency Skills by 30-35% for 8 seconds, up to 150-175%.

2591884.flavor: To the silent skies, the hunter Etzlek raised his staff and then smote the numen. "Release her!" came his cries as he desecrated the hallowed ground. On the third strike, the spirit answered...
2591884.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_012_x1
2591884.power: Your Basic Skills deal 90-110% increased damage and always use their 3rd attack. Every 3rd cast of a Basic Skill strikes three times.

2591887.flavor: "Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII
2591887.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_016_x1
2591887.power: Your Core Skills are now additionally Basic Skills and free to cast. When cast at Maximum Vigor, your Core Skills Consume all Vigor to cast at their largest Size, and become guaranteed Critical Strikes, with 0.5-0.6% increased Critical Strike Damage for each point of Vigor spent this way.

2591889.flavor: The inner curve of this band is lined with thorns that tear the skin whenever it is unbound.
2591889.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_001_x1
2591889.power: Every time you deal Thorns damage, you gain 7-10 Vigor. Gain Toxic Skin's Passive Effect.

2591891.flavor: "Within this corpse-bound carapace we writhe. Chaotic winds converge to churn your bones. Our beat and breath a ceaseless war to break. The wretched cyclone black beyond the bounds." - Balazan's Dream
2591891.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_002_x1
2591891.power: A Pestilent Swarm spawns from you every 4 seconds, dealing # Poison damage per hit. Your Pestilent Swarms now orbit around you and reduce an equipped Eagle Skill's cooldown by 0.25 seconds per hit.

2591893.flavor: "At midnight laughed the second brother, Nebahayomo, spirit of cunning. Trickery is his blessing, suffering is his prayer. Honor him and shrewdness shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse V
2591893.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_006_x1
2591893.power: When you Critically Strike, you regain 40-50% of the Vigor you've spent in the last 2 seconds. Gain Counterattack's Passive Effect.

2591896.flavor: "Strike once to expose weakness, strike again to exploit it." -Teachings of Ysevete, the First Spiritborn
2591896.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_101
2591896.power: You deal 53.33-66.67% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies. After making an enemy Vulnerable, your next direct damage dealt to them: Heals you for 5% of your Maximum Life Generates 10 Vigor Removes the Vulnerable effect

2591898.flavor: "Nahantu is everchanging. Nahantu is everlasting. When the Burning Hells become ash and soot, and when the High Heavens come crashing down, Nahantu will remain." -Excerpt from Defiance of Enkasi
2591898.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_102
2591898.power: The Base Spirit of a Skill cast grants: Eagle: #% Movement Speed Gorilla: #% Damage Reduction Jaguar: #% Attack Speed Centipede: #% Life per Second Casting a Skill of a different Base Spirit: Swaps to the new bonus Increases Core Stats by 100% for 7 seconds.

2591900.flavor: "One touch is all it took...she looked into my eyes. I understood her hunger, endless and painful. I will start with the taverns and find a strong one, with strong blood." -Jios, Sarat's Servant
2591900.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_103
2591900.power: Your Critical Strikes cause your Poisoning on an enemy to burst, dealing 166.67-200% of the total Poisoning instantly to them and 10% of the burst to surrounding enemies before removing the Poisoning effect from the primary target.

2591902.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.
2591902.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_003_x1
2591902.power: Casting Evade consumes 1 |4stack:stacks; of Resolve to increase your damage dealt by 50-60% for 5 seconds. Gain Armored Hide's Passive Effect.

2591904.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture
2591904.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_004_x1
2591904.power: While you have at least 4 stacks of Ferocity, you gain 15-20% increased damage and 60-80% increased Armor. Gaining Ferocity also grants Resolve.

2591906.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV
2591906.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_005_x1
2591906.power: Your Maximum Vigor is increased by 50%, and killing an enemy grants you 7-10 Vigor. While you have Ferocity, your new Poisoning effects last 33% longer.

2592146.flavor: "I have lost, more than I can put into words. Perhaps there are better ways to express loss than words...." -Rathma
2592146.name: Ring_Unique_Necro_102
2592146.power: A dark aura surrounds you, inflicting Decrepify and Iron Maiden on enemies around you and increasing your damage to Close enemies by 10-15%. Curses inflicted this way spread to surrounding targets every second.

2592852.flavor: As he fought with side by side with Raekor to liberate the labor camp, Joritz claimed this dented helm from a fallen foe. As his legend grew, its unique shape became synonymous with his great deeds.
2592852.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Barb_100
2592852.power: When you gain Berserking while already Berserk, you become more enraged granting 40-50% increased damage, 6 Fury per second, and 10% Cooldown Reduction.

2592854.flavor: Harrogath, the final bastion of resistance against Baal's assault on Mt. Arreat was destroyed along with the Worldstone. The survivors never forgave the betrayal that led to the loss of their home.
2592854.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Barb_100
2592854.power: Inflicting Damage Over Time on an enemy has up to a 45-60% chance to reduce the Cooldowns of your Skills by 0.5 |4second:seconds;.

2592856.flavor: "Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day." - Sorrowsong for Ramaladni
2592856.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Barb_101
2592856.power: Skills deal 0.35-0.5% increased damage per point of Fury you have, but 7% Fury Drains per second while in combat.

2592858.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.
2592858.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Barb_103
2592858.power: You gain 3-4% increased damage for each damaging Skill you have equipped, and an additional 6-8% for 15 seconds when each of those Skills are used.

2592860.flavor: "Rise clansmen and reclaim our trampled honor! Ancients' blood runs through us all! We are storms: earth breaking, maelstrom wielding. The fire of the gods burn still! They are with us!" -Ealda
2592860.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Barb_100
2592860.power: Your non-Ultimate Skills that summon Ancients will now summon an additional one. Skills that summon Ancients deal 30-40% increased damage.

2592862.flavor: To chain the kin of Bul-Kathos is to gift them a weapon.
2592862.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Barb_101
2592862.power: Casting a damaging Brawling Skill disables it afterwards. When all of these Skills that are on your Action Bar are disabled, they become re-enabled with their Cooldowns refreshed. Brawling Skills you Cast deal 80-100% increased damage for each disabled Skill.

2592864.flavor: Break their bones beneath your weight, Fell their walls and breach their gate. In his halls we'll boast and sing, And praise our honored mountain king!
2592864.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Barb_101
2592864.power: Casting a Basic Skill while at Maximum Fury causes your Fury to increasingly Drain until you run out, during which your Basic skills now cleave dealing 45-60% increased damage.

2592866.flavor: "Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always." - Talic, to Madawc
2592866.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Barb_100
2592866.power: After spending 30 Fury within 5 seconds, your next non-Channeled Core or Weapon Mastery Skill Cast within 5 seconds is a guaranteed Critical Strike and deals 50-60% bonus Critical Strike Damage. Excess Fury grants 1% additional bonus.

2592868.flavor: An old mark of office from the town of Staalbreak, in the Dreadlands. The rage of its last owner still emanates from within.
2592868.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb_102_x2
2592868.power: Berserking's damage bonus is increased by 56.66-73.33%. While not Healthy, you are always Berserk.

2592870.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker
2592870.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb_103_x2
2592870.power: Casting a Skill with a Two-Handed Bludgeoning, Two-Handed Slashing, or Dual-Wielded weapon grants 15-20% increased damage for 15 seconds. While all three bonuses are active, you gain 25% Crowd Control Duration and Attack Speed.

2592872.flavor: "O Crane, what news do you bring from our mountain? Long have I been away, in strange lands. I yearn for home, for the highland snows, Why silent, Crane? Have you no news from Arreat?"
2592872.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb_104_x2
2592872.power: Core Skills deal 30-40% increased damage, but cost 25% more Fury. The damage is doubled against Injured and Healthy enemies.

2592874.flavor: Ever watchful were the Patriarchs, as the Unclean slowly made their way out of the Dreadlands.
2592874.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb_105_x2
2592874.power: When inflicting Damage Over Time, you have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to increase the damage amount by 75-90%.

2592967.flavor: Hatred begins the first cut. Terror holds the wound. Destruction comes at last, patient and certain, to devour what remains.
2592967.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HSword_Unique_Warlock_001
2592967.power: Hitting enemies with a Core Skill increases the damage they take from you by 15-20% per Skill, up to 45-60%. Archfiend Demonform Skill Variants are Core Skills and cost Wrath.

2592971.flavor: "The Primes warred, but not for glory. They did so for the joy of mayhem. How many legions of demons died simply to delight the lords of Hell?" -Tal Rasha
2592971.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HMace_Unique_Warlock_001
2592971.power: You can now equip all Ultimate Skills and gain 15 Ranks in them. Hitting enemies with Non-Ultimate Skills builds up your Ultimate Skill damage by 0.85-1.25%, up to 85-125%. After starting Ultimate Skills the damage bonus is reset once all have ended.

2592973.flavor: "I am the voice of vengeance unsated. Brandish me and my enmity shall walk with thine. Thy grief is thy tithe. My dirge, the dread reward."
2592973.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HAxe_Unique_Warlock_001
2592973.power: Your Basic Skills deal 0.4-0.5% increased damage per Wrath you have but you lose 10% Wrath per second. Every 50 Wrath gained beyond your Maximum generates 1 Dominance.

2592975.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." - Master Horazon
2592975.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warlock_001
2592975.power: Your Demonology Skills deal 0.4-0.5% increased damage per Wrath you have and you take 0.13-0.17% reduced damage per Dominance you have.
