2592977.flavor: "Therefore, behold, the days come that it shall no more be called thine own body, nor thine own heart, but the heart of Moloch, for each heartbeat shall roar with the flames of Hell..." -Taphya 3:26
2592977.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warlock_002
2592977.power: Hellfire Skills deal 13-20% increased damage for every Skill you have Empowered by Volatility. Casting a Volatility Empowered Skill increases you Core Stats by 5% for 10 seconds, up to 50%.

2592979.flavor: "Sleep, my child, shut fast thine eyes, Keep thee still until sunrise. Astrogha's brood will hear thy breath, And lull thee close to dreaming death." -Westmarch lullaby
2592979.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warlock_003
2592979.power: Your Abyss Skills deal 6-8% increased damage for each stack of Shadowform. This bonus is increased by 100% while you have Stealth.

2592983.flavor: "The morlu are incredibly resilient. Stories from the Sin War describe them fighting despite heavy wounds." -Book of Adria
2592983.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Warlock_004
2592983.power: You cannot recover above 65% of your Maximum Life but your Defensive Skills deal 300-400% increased damage.

2592985.flavor: "...Our rites are written not with ink, but with blood. Not upon stone, but upon the living flesh..." – The Forbidden Ledger
2592985.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Warlock_001
2592985.power: Sigil Skills deal 70-90% increased damage. Active Sigils gain 1 |4kill:kills; every second and unused kills are saved when they expire.

2594388.flavor: "Necromancers uphold the Balance between Light and Dark, life and death. Yet it is only natural, only human, that an individual might tend toward one or the other." -Deckard Cain
2594388.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Necro_101
2594388.power: Shadow damage infects enemies with Shadowblight for 2 seconds. Every 6th time an enemy receives Shadow damage from you while they are affected by Shadowblight, they take an additional 500-600% of that damage as Corrupting damage over 4 seconds.

2594390.flavor: "My companion swung her odd weapon in a wide arc, and our pursuer stopped short. The look of horror on his face as his body fell to pieces will haunt me forever." -The Ebon Pages, Canto II, Verse XI
2594390.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HScythe_Unique_Necro_100
2594390.power: Your Darkness Skills Chill enemies for up to 100% and deal 100-125% increased damage to Frozen enemies and bosses. Every 800 times you damage enemies with Darkness Skills, all Nearby enemies are Feared for 0.25 seconds before Freezing for 3 more seconds.

2594392.flavor: "The spark of life flows through blood, just as the spark of unlife flows through desiccated bone. There is power in both, if one knows how to use it." -Necromancer Zayl
2594392.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Necro_100_x2
2594392.power: Gain 2 Maximum Overpower. Blood Orbs grant 2 stacks of Overpower. Your Blood Skills consume 1 stack of Overpower to deal 86.67-100% increased damage.

2594394.flavor: "Prey not on innocents, but instill fear in those who would." -Books of Kalan
2594394.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Necro_102
2594394.power: Vulnerable, Weakened, Crowd Controlled, or Corrupted enemies are Afflicted, taking 60% increased damage from you. Curse Skills deal # Shadow damage when applied to Afflicted enemies.

2594396.flavor: A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.
2594396.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Necro_100
2594396.power: Your Summons have a 7-10% chance to randomly inflict Decrepify or Iron Maiden when they deal damage. You deal 50-60% increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies affected by your Curses.

2594398.flavor: "Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain
2594398.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Necro_100_x2
2594398.power: Your Minions gain 30-35% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance. When one of your Minions die, your other Minions enrage, dealing 30-35% increased damage for 3 seconds.

2594400.flavor: "I have lost, more than I can put into words. Perhaps there are better ways to express loss than words...." -Rathma
2594400.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Necro_102
2594400.power: A dark aura surrounds you, inflicting Decrepify and Iron Maiden on enemies around you and increasing your damage to Close enemies by 10-15%. Curses inflicted this way spread to surrounding targets every second.

2596127.flavor: "There is a point one can reach, a oneness with the Balance, when a single, silent gesture is enough to summon an army of bone to your command." -Necromancer Mehtan
2596127.name: Gloves_Unique_Necro_105
2596127.power: Your Essence Generation is increased by 30-40%. Your Bone Skills deal 0.5% increased damage for each point of Essence you have when Cast, up to 60-80%.

2596492.flavor: "There is a point one can reach, a oneness with the Balance, when a single, silent gesture is enough to summon an army of bone to your command." -Necromancer Mehtan
2596492.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Necro_105
2596492.power: Your Essence Generation is increased by 30-40%. Your Bone Skills deal 0.5% increased damage for each point of Essence you have when Cast, up to 60-80%.

2596543.flavor: Lo, its strike is thunder, its sting a dirge. Those smote are unmade, scattered as chaff before the breath of ancients.
2596543.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HMace_Unique_Sorc_100
2596543.power: For each Defensive Skill not on your Action Bar, you deal 15-25% increased damage and gain its associated Enchantment effect.

2596545.flavor: The greatest power is often the shortest lived.
2596545.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Sorc_103_x2
2596545.power: Overpower increases your Pyromancy Skill damage by 13.33-16.67% and size, Mana cost and Cooldowns by 10%.

2596547.flavor: Pillaged from the charred remains of Lord Bareen. It still feels hot to the touch.
2596547.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_103_x2
2596547.power: Your Pyromancy Critical Strike Damage is increased by 60-80% against Healthy enemies and your Pyromancy Critical Strike Chance is increased by 40-60% against Injured enemies. Killing an enemy with a Critical Strike grants both bonuses against all enemies as well as 50% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

2596549.flavor: Made from the finger of a silver-haired mage

2674931.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Warlock_004
2674931.power: Command Laalish is now an Ultimate Skill and deals 100-120% increased damage. Command Laalish's Terror Realm lasts 50% longer and while within your Abyss Skill casts do not break Shadowform Stealth.

2674933.flavor: The Unclean burned the Monastery, and all knowledge within. They beheaded the monks, and kept their tongues. All artifacts were lost - save for this.
2674933.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generic_104_x2
2674933.power: Lightning damage against Close enemies has a 25% chance to grant Resolve and deal 250-300% increased damage.

2674935.flavor: Ksathra's strike roiled the seas, swallowing the land. The sky raged, unleashing devastating storms. In a moment, their empire gone. Their bond forever broken. Her sister, no more.
2674935.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generic_105_x2
2674935.power: Your Freeze effects cause enemies to permanently take 10-15% increased Cold damage from you for each second they are Frozen.

2674937.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.
2674937.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Necro_001
2674937.power: When consuming a Corpse, there is a 40-50% chance to also create a decaying Skeletal Simulacrum that seeks enemies but cannot attack. When it dies, it explodes for # Shadow damage. This effect is treated as a Macabre Skill.

2674939.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer
2674939.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Barbarian_001
2674939.power: Your Weapon Mastery Skills are now also Core Skills that have 100% Cooldown Reduction but cost Fury, dealing 140-160% of normal damage.

2674941.flavor: "Well did she feed her children, and well did her children feed her." -Scosglen folktale
2674941.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001
2674941.power: Petrified enemies have a #% increased chance to be Critically Struck and take #% increased damage. Additionally, Earth Skills Petrify Healthy enemies for 3 seconds.

2674943.flavor: Your incantations are echoed by a chorus of the damned. Wield their torment, their vengeance, their pain against the Hellborne that tortured them.
2674943.name: Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Sorcerer_001
2674943.power: Casting a Core Skill triggers a random equipped Basic Skill at a random enemy which deals #% increased damage.

2677115.flavor: "The fever racks my body. It dances... rhythmless, endless! I fear there is but one remedy. MORE! I must hear more..." -Lester the Farmer
2677115.name: OPAL_Amulet_Unique_Generic_100
2677115.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a 30% chance to Moo when hitting an enemy. Lucky Moo: Up to a 50% chance to summon a Cow that explodes for # Fire damage. This damage is increased by 50% on Tuesdays.
